sharon rogers.name: Sharon Rogers
sharon rogers.origin: Sharon Rogers was born to founding S.H.I.E.L.D. agents Peggy Carter and Steve Rogers, considered living legends for their battles against the Red Skull, shortly after World War II. Following proudly in their footsteps, Sharon soon became an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. herself and eventually took over her father's role as Captain America. Two years into her tenure, Sharon met up with S.H.I.E.L.D.'s tech adviser, Tony Stark, who presented her with a new armor, a new shield and a new weapon, which she mistakenly thought was for her birthday, but was actually for a mission that the Director of S.H.I.E.L.D. was sending her on. Landing on the Blue Area of the Moon, Sharon explored a deep, ancient temple with wall carvings of the Inhuman Royal Family, as well as a Watcher. Finding her target, a dangerous crystal emitting high levels of tachyon's and chronal energies, she was quickly confronted by the Guardians of the Galaxy, claiming the crystal was theirs.
weapons: Blaster Lance: A specialized lance used by Captain America. Holo-Sword Energy Absorbing Shield: A shield that is able to absorb energy.

fields.trivia: Sharon is the first original character from Marvel Future Fight, the second being Luna Snow and the third are Crescent and Io. Interestingly enough, are all characters are of South Korean origin, where Netmarble Games is based. Sharon seems to be a counterpart to Sharon Carter, who (depending on the reality) is the sister/niece/grandniece of Peggy Carter, and the girlfriend of Steve Rogers. Sharon was born in South Korea while Peggy and Steve were stationed there. NetMarble games, the creator of Sharon, are also located in South Korea. Sharon was introduced, alongside an alternate reality version of her mother, to celebrate the 75th anniversary of her father's creation.

sharon selleck.name: Sharon Selleck
sharon selleck.origin: Sharon Selleck was friends with fellow aspiring actress Julie Angel. Angel had an association with the Fantastic Four through her former roommate Frankie Raye who was dating the Human Torch at the time. When Frankie became a herald of Galactus, Sharon replaced her as Julie's roommate. While working at TV City, Sharon was part of the TV crew that filmed Barbara Walker's interview with the Invisible Girl on the "Woman to Woman" television show. She later met the Torch when he began attending acting classes with Julie, in a failed attempt to begin dating her. Johnny remained oblivious to the fact that Julie was interested in Grey Landers, a fellow classmate, and the fact that Sharon developed an instant crush on Johnny. Sharon began pushing Julie to see Johnny again. But when they attempted to reach him at the Baxter Building they were rudely brushed off by who they thought was the receptionist, but in reality it was the Negative Zone ruler known as Annihilus who was attempting to destroy both his anti-matter universe and that of Earth. When Julie and Sharon went to investigate the matter, they were halted by a barrier that Annihilus placed around the Baxter Building. Eventually the Fantastic Four returned home and defeated Annihilus. Later, when Johnny began hunting for an apartment, Julie and Sharon accompanied him on the search. After successfully finding a loft apartment, the trio celebrated by having dinner with Johnny and their friend Norm Tobin. Later, Sharon was on her way to a gig with her band the Rolling Dead when he car broke down in the town of King's Crossing. There she stumbled upon a bizarre locals who had mutated into xenophobic shapeshifters by milk taken from a group of Skrulls turned into cows. Unsure of what she had uncovered, she found the locals less than inviting and they constantly impeded her attempts to try and get out of town. Her meals tainted with Skrull milk, Sharon's allergy to dairy products began to flare up. Failing to call Julie for help, Sharon managed to flee the locals to a nearby payphone and try and get a call to the Fantastic Four, but she was recaptured. However, because of he frantic phone calls, Julie was able to get ahold of the Fantastic Four who went to investigate. There they uncovered the bizarre plot, stopped the mutated farmers and freed Sharon. Back in New York City, Sharon visited Johnny at his new apartment and tried to make a move on him. He rebuffed her advances due to his continued interest in Julie Angel, then he left due to an emergency before Sharon could explain him of Julie's interest in a different guy. Sharon tried again to win Johnny over, but failed to do so as Johnny gave up on Julie and began pursuing Alicia Masters instead. Sharon dropped from sight shortly thereafter, her current activities are unknown.
weaknesses: Sharon is allergic to dairy products.

sharon ventura clone.name: Sharon Ventura (Clone)
sharon ventura clone.origin: Judged by his fellow Watchers for his constant interference in the lives of the people of Earth, Uatu was forced to train a young Watcher named Aron on the Watchers code of non-interference. However, after an interaction with the Fantastic Four, Aron became obsessed with not just observing, but controlling the events of those he watched. Developing a suit of armor that rendered him invisible to Uatu's gaze and procuring the android Dragon Man, Aron sought to obtain the DNA samples of the Fantastic Four. With the help of the Frightful Four, Aron succeeded in his task. He then created clones of the existing members of the Fantastic Four, Mister Fantastic, the Invisible Woman, the Human Torch, the Thing, and Ms. Marvel. With the real Fantastic Four put in suspended animation so he could watch their dreams, Aron sent the clones out into the world to take their place. Their first order of business was to recreate the first battle against the Fantastic Four's oldest foe, the Mole Man. Raising the previously sunken Monster Isle from the ocean floor, the cloned Fantastic Four attacked the Mole Man and his minions. After defeating their foes, the clones fled the island after setting off a massive explosion. Seeking to recreate the Fantastic Four's encounter with the Miracle Man, the clones later attacked an innocent magician during a stage performance and exposed how he performed his magic tricks to an increasingly hostile crowd. Feeling under appreciated for their "efforts", the clone of Mister Fantastic suggested that they begin charging a "Fantasti-Tax" in order to pay for their services. Eventually the activities of the clones attracted the attention of the Avengers and Doctor Strange who came to believe that some outside force had changed the real Fantastic Four's personalities. However before the fight could get out of hand, the clones all found themselves teleported back to Aron's hideout in the Rocky Mountains. There they discovered that the Fantastic Four and Frightful Four had broken free and were battling it out, while Aron himself was trapped in suspended animation. The Fantastic Four and their clones battled it out with one another until the real Fantastic Four defeated them. Freeing himself from suspended animation, Aron came to the conclusion that experiencing the dreams of others was more fascinating than their real life exploits, he sent the Frightful Four to the Vault, the real Fantastic Four home, and spirited off to manipulate the dreams of his clones. Although Aron has appeared since, there has been no word on the final fate of his clones.
powers: On par with the real Ms. Marvel.

sharp.name: Sharp
sharp.species: Ex-soldier infused with Lord Ogun's spirit
sharp.origin: ===Early Years=== Not much is known about Sharp's life before the Weapon X Program. ===Delta Soldier=== At some point in his life, Sharp served as a Delta Force soldier. ===Death of Wolverine=== By unknown and unclear reasons, Major Sharp originally joined the revamped Weapon X Program voluntarily. Dr. Cornelius said he made him perfect, as he enhanced every system of his body, enough to get the upper-hand in a fight against Wolverine. But this last one tricked him into punching the glass where Cornelius was, so Logan knocked Sharp out, leaving him apparently dead. ===Weapon X=== After waking up in the destroyed Paradise facility with no memory of who was he or the voice in his head, Sharp and other Paradise subjects escaped after being attacked. Believing the voice in his head was that of Wolverine, Sharp sought out Sabretooth who only confirmed (after a fight) that the other person in his head wasn't Logan. After the other subjects were hunted down, Lord Ogun revealed himself, and tried to take control, but failed after Sharp realized Ogun was weak, but decided not to get rid of him as he needed his abilities to rescue the others. After successfully taking down many other subjects, Neuro informed him that they are all disposable, and had a genetic time bomb placed to kill them. The key to stop it was the regenerative healing factor of various previous mutant subjects, the "Wolverines", which they had to find. ===Wolverines=== After successfully finding and kidnapping the “Wolverines” (Mystique, Daken, Sabretooth, Lady Deathstrike, and X-23), and threatening them with the “control words” (that manipulate, sedate or even kill each of them), Shogun, Neuro, Endo, Skel, and Junk teamed-up with them to find the Adamantium-petrified body of Wolverine in the burnt-down Paradise facility, when they encountered and fought the Wrecking Crew, who had been hired by Mr. Sinister to search for the same. When X-23 and Daken found the body, Mr. Sinister appeared, took Wolverine's body, plus an eye and arm from Daken, and left. Apparently, Daken lost his healing factor. On the Changeling ship, Sharp used a regen serum made by Dr. Cornelius that he found in the wreckage to stabilize and save Daken, against Ogun's wishes. When the team started to plan how to retrieve Wolverine's body, Neuro told Sharp that there was another Paradise subject who was the perfect thief and the only one able to help penetrate Mister Sinister's nigh-impenetrable base: Fantomelle. The team arrived at Fantomelle's place at the time she was being attacked by Siphon, the monster who stole Daken's healing factor. After a brutal fight alongside Skel, Shogun threw a grenade at Siphon, seemingly killing it. Back at the Changeling, while Sharp, Neuro, Fantomelle and her fox Culpepper made plans for the invasion, Fantomelle realized through body language that Sharp was having an internal conversation with Ogun, and warned him that if he trusted him over her inside Mister Sinister's base, it would get him killed. The team dropped for a surprise attack when they were caught mid-air by Sarky Gripes, a servant of Mr. Sinister who was expecting them and wanted to learn more about them, refusing to let them leave. When Endo tried to escaped, Sarky activated some sort of hole where she felt. Sharp killed Sarky, but more “Gripes” showed up, all clones. Once the team was inside Sinister's fortress, he told them that many of his experiments needed field testing against unpredictable opponents as them, and if they survived he might let them live. The team was suddenly separated, Shogun ending up with Neuro and Skel. They were attacked by a clone of Fin Fang Foom who had half of a Thor attached to the end of its tongue. Skel punched its guts and Shogun defeated it by cutting off and killing the Thor part. Neuro then analyzed the creature and told Sharp that Sinister could cure them and there was no need for Wolverine, prompting him to offer Sinister complete control over the "Wolverines" in exchange for curing them. When the X-Men appeared demanding Wolverine's body, Sinister told Neuro he accepted his offer; so, against Shogun's wishes, he used a control word on Lady Deathstrike and put her under Sinister's control, although the rest of the "Wolverines" blocked or damaged their ears to avoid it. While Neuro thought of this action insane, Shogun explained it was simply warfare. Then, Fantomelle, after stealing Wolverine's body and bending herself through the dimensions of Sinister's vacuum trap, tried to escape with the body, but Nightcrawler appeared and teleported away with the Wolverine for the X-Men. While Endo, Neuro, and Skel remained with Mr. Sinister, Sharp and Junk stayed with the Wolverines. Mystique then declared herself as the leader of the team, and made Sharp help her retrieve the zhulong (or "sun dragon") on Taipei, and told him that Lady Deathstrike was interested in him, but Sharp thought she didn't because he held her secret words, thus making her wa
weapons: Since becoming Shogun, he has been seen carrying a Japanese sword (probably a katana) in his back and a knife below his right shoulder.

equipment: Like Ogun, Sharp always carries a mask. Regen Serum: Sharp possesses samples of the Regen Serum created by Dr. Abraham Cornelius.

fields.trivia: Sharp's true face has never been shown, though in one frame when looking into a mirror he sees Wolverine's looking back at him. However, it should be noted this is from his own perspective, so whether this is actually what it looks like, or just how Sharp sees himself is unclear. The few glimpses we get of him without his mask earlier in the issue suggest the latter, as the features don't match the reflection. Shogun was a hereditary military governor in Japan during the shogunate period from 1192 to 1867.

sharpest thorn.name: Sharpest Thorn
sharpest thorn.origin: Sharpest Thorn was a member of the Dark Harvest, a secret and deadly sect of the Priests of Pama, who were empowered with plant-based abilities by the Cotati. In the wake of the Cotati's invasion of Earth, the Priests of Pama detected the arrival on the planet of Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm and N'Kalla Masters-Grimm, two child soldiers of the Kree and the Skrulls, respectively, who were imbued with the chronoicles of each side of the Kree/Skrull War. At the time, the two kids were also under the protection of Franklin and Valeria Richards of the Fantastic Four. The Dark Harvest tracked down Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm and N'Kalla Masters-Grimm to the front steps of the 4 Yancy Street, where they combated three alies of the Fantastic Four, Spider-Man, Wolverine and Sky. During the battle, Sharpest Thorn attempted to subdue Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm with a barrage of poisoned thorns, but her attack was shielded by Sky. After securing Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm, the Dark Harvest was driven away when Franklin and Valeria used image inducers to impersonate Ghost Rider and the Hulk. Sharpest Thorn attacked Wolverine with a barrage of poisoned thorns to prevent him from following them. The Dark Harvest then raided an Alchemax facility to steal a neutronic wave front inducer. With it, they built an Omni-Wave Projector and forced Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm to beam memories of his people's conflict with the Skrulls into the mind of every Kree. N'Kalla Masters-Grimm tracked down Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm and attempted to free him, but was captured and paired with him to also inflict every Skrull with a similar psychic intrusion. The resulting mental attack awakened the buried enmity between the Kree and the Skrull, risking to break apart their Alliance during their war against the Cotati. Franklin, Valeria, Spider-Man and Wolverine tracked down N'Kalla Masters-Grimm in turn and confronted the Dark Harvest. Valeria and Franklin managed to make Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm and N'Kalla Masters-Grimm focus on their shared bond, changing the Omni-Wave Projector's beam into one which fueled the Alliance's bond. As soon as he noticed the Dark Harvest's failure, Lord Quoi of the Cotati turned their plant powers against them, turning them into trees.
abilities: Martial Artist: Sharpest Thorn, like all members of the Dark Harvest, is a proficient martial artist.

After securing Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm, the Dark Harvest was driven away when Franklin and Valeria used image inducers to impersonate Ghost Rider and the Hulk. Sharpest Thorn attacked Wolverine with a barrage of poisoned thorns to prevent him from following them. The Dark Harvest then raided an Alchemax facility to steal a neutronic wave front inducer. With it, they built an Omni-Wave Projector and forced Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm to beam memories of his people's conflict with the Skrulls into the mind of every Kree. N'Kalla Masters-Grimm tracked down Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm and attempted to free him, but was captured and paired with him to also inflict every Skrull with a similar psychic intrusion. The resulting mental attack awakened the buried enmity between the Kree and the Skrull, risking to break apart their Alliance during their war against the Cotati. Franklin, Valeria, Spider-Man and Wolverine tracked down N'Kalla Masters-Grimm in turn and confronted the Dark Harvest. Valeria and Franklin managed to make Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm and N'Kalla Masters-Grimm focus on their shared bond, changing the Omni-Wave Projector's beam into one which fueled the Alliance's bond. As soon as he noticed the Dark Harvest's failure, Lord Quoi of the Cotati turned their plant powers against them, turning them into trees.

sharra neramani.name: Sharra Neramani
sharra neramani.origin: ===Origin=== Deathcry was a member of the Shi'ar. Her true name was taken by royal decree, and Deathcry was a dissident to the Shi'ar Empire, follower of Deathbird. ===Avengers=== When the Earth hero team Avengers defeated the Shi'ar enemies, the Kree, the empress Lilandra Neramani feared for the team's safety should the Kree attempt revenge. Lilandra then ordered Deathcry to join the Avengers as their protector. Deathcry served with the Avengers for several months, hiding her youth but she soon softened and revealed her true age as she formed close friendships with her teammates Vision and Hercules. Later, after the Avengers survived a decimating attack by the villain Immortus, Deathcry decided her services were no longer required. She bade Hercules to return her to the Shi'ar empire, where she remained for a time. ===Annihilation: Conquest=== At some point, she made her way into the Kree Galaxy, and following the overtaking of Hala by the Phalanx, she was discovered as a prisoner in a Kree rebel outpost. Placed on a commando team led by Star-Lord and filled with other Kree prisoners, they were inserted on an unnamed world held by the Phalanx with the sole mission of destroying a Phalanx replication plant. While on this mission, she began threatening Captain Universe for "taking her kills." After one such "theft", she made to attack Vargas, and in self-defense, he reduced her to a pile of bones and organs. ===Chaos War=== With the invasion of Earth's dimension by the entity called the Chaos King, Deathcry (along with other deceased Avengers Captain Marvel, Doctor Druid, the Vision, Yellowjacket, and the original Swordsman), returned from the dead. When Mar-Vell was killed again by the Grim Reaper, Deathcry inherited his cosmic awareness and became an enhanced version of herself as Lifecry. Although she managed to defeat Nekra, she also died in the end.
powers: Deathcry's agility, balance, and bodily coordination were all enhanced to levels beyond the natural physical limits of the finest human athlete.
Her reflexes were similarly enhanced and were superior to those of the finest human athlete.
After the death of Mar-Vell, the Cosmic Awareness power gifted to him by Eon chose Sharra as its new host, turning her into Lifecry.
weaknesses: Deathcry was prone to berserker rages that made her reckless in combat situations. This reckless abandon is ultimately what caused her death.

sharrr.name: Sharrr
sharrr.first_appearance: All-New Marvel NOW! Point One Vol 1 1.NOW
sharrr.origin: Cap'n Sharrr was the leader of a group of pirates on the planet Nautikos. During the celebration of the Festival of Light, he and his crew attacked the spectators of a show of cosmic rays (the animals, not to be confused with the phenomenon) for being in "his docks." The Silver Surfer was one of the spectators, and proceeded to defeat the pirates, starting with Sharrr. Some time later, Sharrr tried to get revenge on the Surfer, and followed him to Elysius 5. During a picnic, the Surfer silvered down, and was caught off guard by Sharrr. Surfer's companion Dawn Greenwood warned him, and prevented the Surfer from being beheaded. Norrin then silvered up and proceeded to scare Sharrr away.

shastra.name: Shastra
shastra.origin: Shastra, like every Eternal, was created by the Celestials one million years ago. 400,000 years later, a civil war erupted between two factions of the Eternals: the side of Kronos, who cherished piece and non-interference, and the side of Uranos, wanting to use their powers to dominate the planet. Shastra joined Uranos' side, but they were defeated by Kronos' forces and banished from the Earth. When the two dozen exiles landed on the planet Uranus, they conquered the Kree outpost there to make of it their new home. As the Eternal Uranos built a spaceship to return to Earth, Astron refused to follow his ways any longer and, along with three sympathizers, remained on planet Uranus, where they created their own colony. Shastra accompanied Uranos on his way back to Earth, but their spaceship was destroyed by a Kree fleet investigating the invasion of their outpost, leaving only Shastra, Uranos, and 5 other Eternals alive. The survivors finally decided to abandon their plans for revenge and, instead, created a colony on Saturn's moon of Titan. At some point, however, the Titanians fell to warlike tendencies once more, and, as a result, the colony of Titan was ravaged by yet another civil war, thereby causing the death of all its residents, save for Sui-San, who lived in isolation. After her death, Shastra was resurrected on Earth, in the Exclusion, where she was mind-wiped alongside the other exiles. After that, they joined Oceanus, who had retired to a vigil of Deviants. Together, they became known as the Oceanic Watch (with the exception of Uranos, who was imprisoned in the Exclusion).
powers: Eternal Physiology: Like all Eternals, Shastra's natural physiology grants her a number of superhuman physical attributes.

shathra.name: Shathra
shathra.origin: thumb|left|Shathra in her original form ===Origin=== Shathra hailed from Earth-001 before it became Loomworld. Born to the goddesses Oshtur and Gaea, she was entrusted with designing the Celestial Map of Humanity. After painstaking effort, Shathra conceived the "Great Nest" a rigid lattice of interconnected order, reflecting her vision of a perfectly stratified cosmos where every strand had a fixed place. Her younger sister Neith saw flaw in its inflexibility, instead weaving the more fluid "Great Web." When their mothers judged both works, they praised Neith’s design, which they deemed resilient, adaptive, and brimming with free will. It was chosen to become the basis of the Web of Life and Destiny. Shathra's pride was shattered. To her, the Great Web was not elegance but chaos, disorder, and weakness. She outwardly congratulated her sister, but inwardly seethed with envy and contempt. Her bitterness warped her spirit until she transformed into a wasp-goddess of predation, stingers, and venom. She declared that her "brood" of wasp-spawn would one day replace the Web, binding all existence into her Great Nest. ===Hunting Prey=== 250px|thumb|right Shathra first sensed Spider-Man while he traversed the Astral Plane in pursuit of Shade. Recognizing him instantly as a "true totem," she marked him as prey. Crossing into Earth-616, Shathra stalked him like a hunter closing on its quarry, demonstrating speed and ferocity beyond his ability to counter. Though Peter eluded her temporarily by exploiting the terrain of New York, she pursued him relentlessly. Shathra then employed deception. Assuming the guise of Sharon Keller, she appeared on live television as a woman claiming to be Peter Parker's bitter ex-girlfriend. She smeared his reputation with fabricated accounts of abandonment and cruelty, painting him as a coward. When Parker lashed out in frustration, she shed her false form mid-broadcast, revealing herself as a monstrous wasp before millions. Her ploy forced Spider-Man into a primal predator-versus-prey duel on her terms. Venom coursing through his veins, Parker was brought to the brink of paralysis. Salvation came from Ezekiel Sims, who drew Shathra to a Ghanaian temple sanctified to the spider-totem. There, Parker surrendered to his arachnid nature, weaving a trap that bound Shathra in webbing. She was left to be consumed by the temple's guardian spider, a humiliation for one who prided herself as predator. Though physically defeated, her essence did not fade. Shathra's venomous presence continued to haunt Parker, surfacing when mystical threats converged on the Web. During Spider-Man's 500th recorded battle, her image was among the hostile totemic forces arrayed against him. Later, during the fallout of the Civil War, her corruptive aura touched Ezekiel's continued entanglements with the spider-totems. Shathra was not confined to Earth-616. In the multiverse, she hunted Spider-Men with equal ruthlessness. On Earth-10995, she targeted its Spider-Man and Ezekiel, and after her banishment to the Astral Plane, she possessed the body of that world's Wasp. Corrupting Janet's form into a vessel for her swarm, she was eventually exorcised by Spider-Man and Ant-Man. Her reach even extended to mythic realms such as the Battlerealm, where she was counted among the monstrous entities summoned to fight in contests between champions. ===The Scarlet Spider=== Shathra's hunger for totemic prey eventually drew her to Kaine Parker, the tormented clone of Peter Parker who had carved out a life for himself in Houston under the mantle of the Scarlet Spider. Unlike Peter, Kaine carried the curse of the Other within him, a powerful and primal spider-totem that made him a uniquely appetizing target for Shathra. Knowing brute force would not suffice, Shathra stalked Kaine through deception. Assuming the guise of his lover Annabelle Adams, she infiltrated his personal life and seduced him, exploiting his longing for normalcy and human connection. At the moment of vulnerability, she revealed her true nature her body twisting into a wasp-like horror before Kaine's eyes. Her intention was not only to slay Kaine but to use his Other essence as breeding stock for her brood. Shathra summoned her wasp-spawn in waves, surrounding Kaine in the skies above Houston and tormenting him with venom, stingers, and hive swarms that whispered her hive-song into his mind. Their endless attacks eroded his will, driving him to the edge of collapse. Yet Shathra's overconfidence proved to be her undoing. Kaine, unlike Peter, did not resist his darker inheritance. Embracing the monstrous Other that lived within him, he underwent a terrifying transformation into a hulking arachnid beast. The tide of battle shifted violently. Where Peter had once fled Shathra in terror, Kaine met her savagery with equal brutality. In a climactic duel, the transformed Scarlet Spider tore through her swarm and grappled with Shathra directly. The clash was not graceful comb

shauna.name: Shauna
shauna.origin: ===Inferno Babies=== Shauna was one of the Inferno Babies used to open portals to Limbo and taken by Project Purgatory. Using information from Cameron Hodge, Ten mutant children were kidnapped, by N'astirh's N'asteris, during the Inferno. The infants arrived in a cemetery, where the demon N'astirh was attempting to create a permanent portal open between the demon infested dimension of Limbo and Earth. The infants were teleported to Times Square, where the New Mutant, Magik, was opening a portal to return her teammates from Limbo and N'astirh, using the babies as the points of an inverted pentagram (focusing beams of power because of their purity and openness to use them as natural, living conduits who could not block the flow of power and who would not know how to shut it off), kept the portal open. N'astirh attempted to used them, and baby Christopher Summers, who later grew-up to become Cable, to open a portal from Limbo to Earth and was partially successful in merging the two realms. The X-Terminators and the New Mutants saved the children. After the defeat of N'astirh, the Goblin Queen attempted to sacrifice baby Christopher and the other nine mutant babies atop the Empire State Building to finish N'astirh's work and permanently open a gateway between Earth and Limbo. The invasion was thwarted after the Goblin Queen committed suicide in combat with Marvel Girl, attempting to kill everyone in her power. After the X-Terminators and New Mutants took the babies to X-Factor's Celestial Ship, X-Factor turned the babies over to the US government, while being attacked by Nanny and Orphan-Maker. ===Project Purgatory=== For many years the fate of children remained unknown. Following the Inferno, the United States Army founded Project Purgatory to research the fields of the supernatural and paranormal. One of the recruited scientists, Doctor Noc, developed technology to use the children to open portals to Limbo. General Ulysses, Doctor Noc, and a trained band of military soldiers established a military base in Limbo, the Hatchery. At the base, they continued to experiment, both on demons and on the Inferno babies, and train new soldiers. However, when the soldiers recovered the Bloodstone amulet, the base was attacked by Witchfire and the Inferno babies were believed dead. The Earth based military forces sealed off the portal Epsilon, leaving those on the Limbo base stranded to find the observation portal with virtually no hope of escape. After 26 years in Limbo, but only 4 years on Earth, Noc and Ulysses were able to locate a traveling portal and return home, keeping the existence of the children to themselves. However, they never gave up their mission of taking control of Limbo and capturing Illyana Rasputin. They returned to a world where all of the mutants were living together, on Utopia. and, therefore, their commanding officer, General Combest, ordered them to stand-down. The unit still believed that Illyana was a significant threat and, after Project Purgatory kidnapped Pixie, the Inferno Babies revealed themselves when they killed General Combest and obliterated the entire battalion. The New Mutants showed to rescue Pixie and the Inferno Babies defeated them. After Dr. Noc and General Ulysses took Illyana's Soulsword and Pixie's Souldagger, they extracted the Bloodstones and completed the Bloodstone Amulet to call forth the Elder Gods. They, along with members of Project Purgatory, tortured the New Mutants. Once they returned to Limbo, the Demons Three asked them to turn over the Bloodstone Amulet and General Ulysses had them beg for mercy, then killed. After releasing the Elder Gods, General Ulysses was killed attempting to control them and the group fought against a demon horde. While fighting, Shauna's whereabouts were unknown.

The infants were teleported to Times Square, where the New Mutant, Magik, was opening a portal to return her teammates from Limbo and N'astirh, using the babies as the points of an inverted pentagram (focusing beams of power because of their purity and openness to use them as natural, living conduits who could not block the flow of power and who would not know how to shut it off), kept the portal open. N'astirh attempted to used them, and baby Christopher Summers, who later grew-up to become Cable, to open a portal from Limbo to Earth and was partially successful in merging the two realms. The X-Terminators and the New Mutants saved the children. After the defeat of N'astirh, the Goblin Queen attempted to sacrifice baby Christopher and the other nine mutant babies atop the Empire State Building to finish N'astirh's work and permanently open a gateway between Earth and Limbo. The invasion was thwarted after the Goblin Queen committed suicide in combat with Marvel Girl, attempting to kill everyone in her power. After the X-Terminators and New Mutants took the babies to X-Factor's Celestial Ship, X-Factor turned the babies over to the US government, while being attacked by Nanny and Orphan-Maker. ===Project Purgatory=== For many years the fate of children remained unknown. Following the Inferno, the United States Army founded Project Purgatory to research the fields of the supernatural and paranormal. One of the recruited scientists, Doctor Noc, developed technology to use the children to open portals to Limbo. General Ulysses, Doctor Noc, and a trained band of military soldiers established a military base in Limbo, the Hatchery. At the base, they continued to experiment, both on demons and on the Inferno babies, and train new soldiers. However, when the soldiers recovered the Bloodstone amulet, the base was attacked by Witchfire and the Inferno babies were believed dead. The Earth based military forces sealed off the portal Epsilon, leaving those on the Limbo base stranded to find the observation portal with virtually no hope of escape. After 26 years in Limbo, but only 4 years on Earth, Noc and Ulysses were able to locate a traveling portal and return home, keeping the existence of the children to themselves. However, they never gave up their mission of taking control of Limbo and capturing Illyana Rasputin. They returned to a world where all of the mutants were living together, on Utopia. and, therefore, their commanding officer, General Combest, ordered them to stand-down. The unit still believed that Illyana was a significant threat and, after Project Purgatory kidnapped Pixie, the Inferno Babies revealed themselves when they killed General Combest and obliterated the entire battalion. The New Mutants showed to rescue Pixie and the Inferno Babies defeated them. After Dr. Noc and General Ulysses took Illyana's Soulsword and Pixie's Souldagger, they extracted the Bloodstones and completed the Bloodstone Amulet to call forth the Elder Gods. They, along with members of Project Purgatory, tortured the New Mutants. Once they returned to Limbo, the Demons Three asked them to turn over the Bloodstone Amulet and General Ulysses had them beg for mercy, then killed. After releasing the Elder Gods, General Ulysses was killed attempting to control them and the group fought against a demon horde. While fighting, Shauna's whereabouts were unknown.

sheila conklin.name: Sheila Conklin
sheila conklin.origin: Sheila Conklin was a businesswoman, the head of Conklin Industries. She hired a man called Curt Ranklin to save her company from financial ruin, fell in love with and became engaged to him, even though she was aware that he was actually one of the Cat People, known as the Cougar, masquerading as a human. Cougar obtained the Null Bands formerly belonging to the robot Tomazooma, but learned that the heroine Tigra, herself a hybrid Cat Person, was on to him. He tracked her to the Baxter Building, where he fought her and her ally the Thing and tried to drain the Thing's powers using the Null Bands. Disgusted with him, Sheila shot Cougar in the back, killing him.

sheila danning.name: Sheila Danning
sheila danning.origin: Sheila Danning was the head of Public Relations for Cross Technological Enterprises. When CTE's then security chief Hawkeye captured a group of criminals after a break-in, she arranged for a photographer to take his picture. Later, Hawkeye went on a date with Sheila. While they were at his apartment, he told her about his background, but they were interrupted when he had an alert about a break-in at CTE. He dealt with the break-in, and captured the perpetrator - the adventurer and spy Mockingbird. Mockingbird told him CTE were corrupt, but he didn't believe her. However, he felt troubled by the suggestion and investigated the company himself. He was attacked by his own security guards, however, who forced him to surrender by apparently threatening Sheila. Hawkeye and Mockingbird were placed in a pit with their weapons confiscated, and when Hawkeye demanded to see Sheila, she arrived and told him her interest in him was just a sham to keep him busy while CTE performed their criminal acts. The pit was gradually filled with toxic waste, but the two heroes escaped. Hawkeye caught up with Sheila and got his bow and arrows back. Although he didn't harm her, Sheila told him CTE would have revenge on him. What form this revenge would take is unknown. Ironically, Sheila's plotting helped bring Hawkeye together with Mockingbird, who he married soon afterward.

sheila donner.name: Sheila Donner
sheila donner.origin: Sheila Donner was a journalist / reporter working for the Public Eye. She first appeared at Johnny testing his new Fireball X-S vehicle at Southern Oregon desert. Her illegal reporting made her and her pilot get busted, but she still wouldn't give up on Johnny when his old schoolmate Mike Snow, whom now working for the FDNY, and one of Mike's teammate Vinnie Costello died because of suddenly self-immolation. When drug-dealer Brandon Crowe's apartment at Brownstone caught on fire, a fireball attacked Crowe. These two incidents made Donner keep an eye on Johnny. She then dressed up as "Firefox" to gain attention of Mike Snow and his partners, she said after her flame controlling device was ignored by a fire department, Sheila used it to commit crimes. She was defeated by Storm as the Human Torch, but it turned out that she and Johnny were working together aiming to find out what the fireball which attacked Crowe was. Later, she called up Rose Delany, Mike's girlfriend, and said she got a video tape capturing Rose who seemed to be not looking too happy when the fireball appeared. After Rose confessed she was the one who used fireball to attack Crowe and made Costello burnt to death, Donner tried to tape down the confession, but Rose burned her camera. Towards to Rose's self-explosion, Donner still wanted to have an interview with Mike. It was turned down by Johnny and Johnny agreed to tell the public through Donner that he burnt Mike when they were at high school , and both now were settled of what happened at the past stay in past.

sheila mason.name: Sheila Mason
sheila mason.origin: Sheila Mason, whose mother died an untimely death, is the daughter of inventor Enoch Mason. After her father developed the "Dimension Smasher" and brought the alien Vision to Earth, she would become a target of "Brains" Borelli, a mobster to whom her father owed money. Captured along with her father and Aarkus, the Vision would defeat Brains and his mob, turning them over to the police. Aarkus would become friends with the Masons, and Sheila would grow very fond of him, being one of the few people to make her smile since her mother passed away. When O'Shaughnessy, (a crook hired by local crime lords to eliminate the Vision) would pose as the Mason's new gardener, he would develop an interest in the girl that was not reciprocated. Learning that Enoch had to shut the portal between Earth's dimension and that of the Vision, O'Shaughnessy would hold Sheila hostage to force the Vision to return to his home. However, the portal would allow a Kalimachh to enter Earth's dimension. After O'Shaughnessy was killed by the Vision, and the hero would go off to stop the monster, Sheila and her father would fight off the fear-inspiring effects of its black smoke to shut down the portal, trapping the Vision on Earth.

sheldon sanders.name: Sheldon Sanders
sheldon sanders.origin: Dr. Sheldon Sanders was a member of the mysterious Diogenes Initiative sent to work as a spy at the Naval Air Station Fallon to keep an eye on their experiments. He was a geneticist who worked on a way to manipulate and introduce purified genes into an ill person's body to eliminate a number of genetic diseases. When looking for a cure for the genetic disease of Abigail Mercury, Ben Reilly found a paper on the internet written by Dr. Sheldon Sanders, and promised himself to visit him. Ben initially contacted Dr. Sanders via email, but since Dr. Sanders didn't handle his emails himself, they were answered by his assistant, who was secretly Karl Lykos, the supervillain Sauron. After Lykos stopped answering emails on Sanders' behalf, Ben infiltrated the Naval Air Station Fallon and personally confronted Dr. Sanders. Sheldon cleared up the misunderstanding, since due to Lykos' interference he was unaware of Abigail's existence. When Dr. Sanders called in his assistant, Ben's spider-sense was triggered, and he webbed up Lykos, prompting him to change into Sauron. During the subsequent fight, Ben tried to escape with Dr. Sanders to keep him safe. After knocking down Reilly, Sauron prepared to kill him. However, Dr. Sanders jumped between the two combatants and Sauron struck him in the back. Ben managed to make some distance escaping with Dr. Sanders. However, Sheldon told him to stop so he could reveal that he was a spy, and that his boss at the Diogenes Initiative had the antidote for Abigail's disease. Sheldon died in Ben's arms after telling him the address where he had to go.

shen quinghao.name: Shen Quinghao
shen quinghao.origin: The person who would eventually adopt the identity of Shen Quinghao was formerly the crime boss known as Silver Fang, a nefarious gangster involved in human trafficking operations, and the person that pushed "Martin Li" to a life of crime. At some point in time, Silver Fang abandoned his life of crime, adopting the identity of Quinghao, and eventually became known as "China's greatest humanitarian." In the present, Quinghao's company decided to invest in Parker Industries' technology on renewable energies. The presentation of the partnership between Parker Industries and Quinghao was interrupted by Mister Negative and his Inner Demons. Mister Negative affected Shen with his powers, and commanded him to start confessing his past. Chief Inspector Sun shot at the camera that could've recorded the confession, because he already knew of Quinghao's past long time ago, but he was willing to keep it under wraps to avoid compromising Shen reputation in favor of the good he was doing for China. Mister Negative fled in frustration, due to being unable to reveal Quinghao's truth to the public, and commanded Quinghao to commit suicide by jumping off the window; however, he was rescued by Spider-Man's allies. After the incident, Quinghao's past remained a secret, but the lead scientist of Parker Industries' renewable energies declined to continue working with him, unwilling to share his hard work with a man like him.

sheoke sanada.name: Sheoke Sanada
sheoke sanada.origin: left|thumb|Snapdragon (Sheoke Sanada) A skilled martial artist, Snapdragon was first seen when she was hired to defeat the Black Widow in Japan. She succeeded in this mission, but Black Widow soon regained her composure and quickly dispatched Snapdragon. Later, Snapdragon joined Superia's all-female superhuman army the Femizons and became one of her lieutenants. There, Snapdragon came across another Femizon recruit, her long-time enemy Diamondback. The two had both been trained by Anaconda in Taskmaster's Academy for training criminal mercenaries, but Diamondback had subsequently dishonored Snapdragon in some way. While on Superia's S.S. Superia cruise ship, Snapdragon faced Diamondback when she was without her trademark throwing diamond weapons. The two fought, and Snapdragon knocked Diamondback unconscious. Snapdragon threw the unconscious Diamondback overboard, leaving her to drown. Diamondback was rescued and eventually recovered, but briefly swore off her life as a costumed mercenary out of fear of dying. After being brutalized and trained by the criminal Crossbones, Diamondback returned to her life of adventuring and sought revenge against Snapdragon. Diamondback tracked Snapdragon to an AIM weapons expo on the island Boca Caliente with her allies Captain America and Falcon and caught Snapdragon unawares. During their rematch, a now more highly trained and ruthless Diamondback overpowered and strangled Snapdragon to death in a fountain. Snapdragon's body was returned to Japan and cremated by her brother, Kono. thumb|Echo breaks her cover to save Moon Knight from Snapdragon ===Side by side with Moon Knight=== Snapdragon somehow returned to life and started working for the Los Angeles Kingpin. Some time later she was confronted by Moon Knight. She and her henchmen got the best of him. However, he was saved by an undercover Echo. Snapdragon hired Night Shift to kill Moon Knight, but the team failed. After Moon Knight and Echo managed to reveal Count Nefaria as the Kingpin, a subdued Snapdragon was left to the police. More recently, Snapdragon worked with Viper, Arcade, and others to gain revenge on Black Widow.
powers: Snapdragon possessed no superhuman abilities of her own.
abilities: Snapdragon was a proficient hand-to-hand combatant, and skilled in using various forms of weaponry.

shep mason.name: Shep Mason
shep mason.origin: Shep Mason and his gang robbed gold shipments heading to Lawson City. He then returned to town a few days later with the stolen loot and cashed it in at the local assayer and drank away his spoils. He bragged about having "found" a mine but would never reveal its location. His boasting came to the ears of Mexican Pete, companion of the Masked Raider. When the Raider got involved in solving the thefts, he baited a trap for Mason and his men: Loading gold samples with a lead solution, the Raider allowed Mason and his men to rob the next shipment without opposition. Later, when he cashed in his stolen loot, the lead inside gave away the fact that it was stolen. With all the proof they needed, the Masked Raider and Mexican Pete rounded up Mason and his men. Later in the Lawson City jail, the once boastful Shep Mason was told by the Raider how he was easily tricked into capture.

sheriff darrell.name: Sheriff Darrell
sheriff darrell.first_appearance: Immortal Hulk: The Threshing Place Vol 1 1
sheriff darrell.origin: Darrell was the sheriff of a town in Toews County. He helped cover up the operations of the Toews County Experimental Farm, which was using gamma radiation to grow crops. When a local girl named Rebecca Green wandered off into the farm, she got mutated into a disfigured monster which terrorized the town, killing three people over three days. When Bruce Banner traveled to this town to investigate Rebecca's disappearance, he found out the experimental farm. When he was being confronted by Rebecca's father Rick for snooping around, having also found him holding Rebecca's hair clip, Darrell and an officer named Les approached them. They arrested Banner, and Darrell brutalized him in the process. At night, the mutated Rebecca rampaged downtown, drawn to Banner's gamma energy. In the process, she attacked Darrell, leaving him trapped under a car with an extensive gash across his torso. When Banner transformed into the Hulk and escaped prison, he stumbled into the result of Rebecca's rampage. He approached Darrell and stepped on him for not warning the locals of the truth behind the experimental farm, killing him.

sherlock dog.name: Sherlock (Dog)
sherlock dog.origin: Sherlock was a labradoodle rescued by Austin Van Der Sleet. Fearing that M.O.D.O.K. and others at A.I.M. were not responding well to his management style, Austin brought in Sherlock to help deliver bad news including confronting M.O.D.O.K. about not delivering the mail and telling Dillman the police were coming due to his "ruff" internet searches. Since rescuing him, Austin had become very close to Sherlock. Wanting to have a companion in his loneliness, Austin asked Hexus the Living Corporation if Sherlock could be spared from the culling of their invasion. When this request was denied, Austin began to work against Hexus' plan. After Hexus told him to kill Sherlock immediately, Austin looked in Monica's lab for technology, hiding in Monica's teleporter once she arrived, causing Austin and Sherlock to merge into a freakish hybrid. When M.O.D.O.K. was able to sell both his and Monica's share to Iron Man, Monica unmerged the two.

sherman wilks.name: Sherman Wilks
sherman wilks.origin: Sherman Wilks was a commander in the Confederate States Army who offered a $1000 death benefit to any man who joined his regiment. After the Confederacy lost the American Civil War, Wilks became a bounty hunter in order to pay off the debt to his men's widows. With only one widow left to pay, Wilks set out to collect the bounty on the outlaw Kid Colt. After a brief truce between the two in order to fight off a gang of scavengers, Wilks challenged Colt to a duel. Wilks lost the duel but ultimately his debt was paid off as Colt and his ally Hawk pretended to be Wilks and collected the bounty, passing off a dead body as that of Kid Colt, using the money to pay Wilks's last widow.

sherna.name: Sherna
sherna.origin: Sherna was one of the last four Followers of the Light on Earth. She was a member of the Lumina race even though she and generations of her ancestors had been born on Earth. Like their ancestors, Sherna and her fellow Followers acted as sentinels against the possible return of their ancient enemies, the Myndai sorcerer-scientist Lord Maur-Kon and his Dark Agents, who had been trapped in suspended animation since the end of the Great Chaos Wars millennia ago. When a volcanic eruption in the early 21st century caused their enemies to finally awaken, Sherna and the other Followers summoned the three humans who their computers had determined would be the best pilots of the Shogun Warrior robots. With the other Followers, Sherna provided support to these three Agents of the Light as they used the Shogun Warriors to battle and defeat various monsters sent against them, first by Lord Maur-Kon and, later, by Doctor Demonicus. Sherna and the other three Followers died when a giant alien monster attacked Shogun Sanctuary. The Agents of the Light arrived in their Shogun Warriors too late to save them but were able to kill the monster when it attacked them. The Agents then buried the bodies of the Followers in graves marked with ankhs on a mountaintop overlooking the ruins of Sanctuary. A month later, the Agents of the Light and the Fantastic Four confronted the alien Primal One who had sent the monster that killed the Followers. During the battle, the Primal One was revealed to be nothing more than a high-tech avatar that Maur-Kon was using to conceal his identity. Once exposed, Maur-Kon was swiftly defeated and taken into custody by the Charter Federation forces that his false Primal One had summoned, under false pretenses, to help him destroy the Shogun Warriors.

shi qaanth.name: Shi Qaanth
shi qaanth.origin: Shi Qaanth was the most powerful of the Cotati and the favored lieutenant of the prophesized Celestial Messiah Quoi. His teachings were followed by many of the other Cotati and he was a powerful mage who could exert control on plant life. When Quoi declared the intention to wipe out all animal life and create their own realm called "Empyre", the first target of the Cotati was the planet Earth. Shi Qaanth and his soldiers attacked Fort Myer in Arlington County, so they could easily take Washington, D.C., but they were forced to flee after Captain America intervened and helped in turning the tide. Shi Qaanth lost his eye after being shot by an American soldier named Bennett, but secretly infected him before leaving. After Captain America met General Woodley, he utilized the infected Bennet to infect the American general as well, while himself preparing to attack Mexico City by creating the Man of Earth using his staff, in order to create a seismic event that would destroy all life on Earth. Shi Qaanth used the infected General Woodley to infiltrate the N.A.T.O. headquarters, while using the infected Bennett to infect the American and Kree/Skull alliance soldiers accompanying Captain America. Captain America and the others were however able to beat the infected soldiers, but he realized that Woodley too had been infected since he had been acting strange earlier. Rushing to Brussels in an Alliance ship, Captain America and the others fought the infected Woodley, who was eliminated by Sergeant Russo using a flamethrower. The united American-Alliance forces went to Mexico City, after receiving promise of help from N.A.T.O. and having already learnt Shi Qaanth's plan. Shi Qaanth drove the Man of Earth towards Mexico City, where Captain America and the Alliance-American attacked the Cotati forces accompanying the beast. The Alliance warships directed their missiles towards the beast and succeeded in greatly damaging him. However he soon retaliated and destroyed the Alliance flagship, while ripping open a fault line. Captain America realized that they needed to stop him quickly and after learning Shi Qaanth was riding him, took an Alliance glider to reach the beast's top, where he confronted the Cotati mage. Shi Qaanth restrained him with the power of his staff and he realized it must have been what was holding the Man of Earth together, before destroying it with his shield. As the Man of Earth disintegrated, Shi Qaanth fell from a great height, most likely to his death.
powers: Can control plant life and also use them to infect humans, making them do his bidding. : Survived his eye area being blasted by a 50-caliber machine gun.
weaknesses: Missing Eye

shialmar.name: Shialmar
shialmar.origin: ===Early Life=== Shialmar was once a princess of a minor kingdom of the great land of Kaichek, apparently oppressed by the Sorcerer Kings. Thanks to the magic of the wizard Vung, the Black Mirror carried the former warrior Kan to their dimension in order to help Prince Jehan of Siridar (Shialmar's brother) defeating the Kings; Kan initially refused to return to his old ways and tried to convince the prince of pacefully deal with their enemies, meanwhile, Kan and Shialmar started a romantic relationship. When the woman was almost killed by a monster apparently sent by the Kings against them (but secretly sent by Vung, instead), Kan decided to help Jehan and led his army against the Sorcerers, but after killing them all, Kan and Shialmar realized how horrible was the war. Later, Vung captured them two and tried to sacrifice them to the N'Garai demons, but Shialmar offered his body to host the demons, they accepted turning her into the Shadowqueen. She then killed Vung, but the N'Garai weren't satisfied, as they wanted the sacrifice of someone she loved, Shialmar chose her brother, unable to hurt Kan, who was sent back to his universe. ===Life as Shadowqueen=== Centuries later, the Shadowqueen engaged a fight against the last of the Sorcerer Kings: Silver Fox; however, she decided to confront her power with the Sorcerer Supreme's one and in order to do so, she sent the Lords of the Golden Dragon kidnapping Wong and Clea. They're successful, but once in Shialmar's dimension, the girl was freed by Silver Fox's outlaws; when the Lords of the Golden Dragon failed in capturing Doctor Strange, Shialmar transformed them all into gargoyles and placed them guarding Wong's cell inside her prison. Meanwhile, Strange had joined Silver Fox's army and when the last Sorcerer King told him where Wong was, he decided to carry out a raid on the prisons at night, even if, as they entered Shialmar's city, Majaedong, the Shadowqueen always known where they was; because of that, when they escaped with Wong, the powerful witch was able to track them, leading her to Silver Fox's hidden camp. Using her mystical powers, Shialmar travelled through shadows until her enemies' camp and launched her attack with monsters that can turn everyone they touch into other monsters. The Shadowqueen decided to face Doctor Strange himself and their fight took place far in the sky, but that didn't forbid Wong trying to hit the evil witch with one of his arrows. He failed and the Shadowqueen hit him with one of her spells, but she was unable to kill him due to him looking like her lost love Kan; while distracted, Dr. Strange cast an extremely powerful spell that broke her link to the N'Garai Demons. Stephen then tried to heal her from the magic injures caused by the broken link, but Shialmar refused and died asking forgiveness for what she did as Shadowqueen.
powers: Magical powers granted by N'Garai

shiela whittier.origin: Shiela Whittier inherited castle Dunwick from her deceased "uncle" Alestar Duncan. Her boyfriend Freddy was killed when they went to go explore the castle. For two months Alestar's ghost tortured her as she lived at the castle. Dracula befriended Sheila as he hoped to later use her as his hypnotized slave to do his bidding in the daylight. Dracula banished Alestar's ghost who claimed that he was going to sacrifice Sheila to the dark gods and that he was not her uncle but in fact her father. He also claimed Sheila's mother was his murderer after he willed her the castle and that after death he assumed the form of another man and became her lover. Dracula and Sheila soon became involved in a relationship and she tricked David Eshcol into aiding Dracula. Sheila freed herself of Dracula's influence however and ran away with David Eshcol. She killed herself to escape from Dracula after he struck her and murdered Eshcol. Dracula lamented her death as he had come to love her.

shilpa khatri.origin: Trinary was a young mutant from India who used her technopathic abilities to top up the accounts of every working Indian woman from the accounts of the twenty-five highest-earning CEOs in the country. The message reached its recipient in Wakanda, resulting in Trinary's liberation from IMDF imprisonment by Jean Grey and her allies. Trinary took control of a Sentinel deployed by the IMDF and used it to escape with her rescuers. When they reached Wakanda, the mutant group was intercepted by Storm, secretly under the influence of Cassandra Nova. After Storm was incapacitated and the Sentinite controlling her was extracted from her brain with Trinary's help, Jean Grey decided to move her base of operations to Searebro. ===X-Men Disassembled=== Trinary was one of the many mutants that fought a crazed X-Man from remaking the world in his image. When X-Man felt that the world would never be improved with the X-Men around, X-Man made all his enemies vanish, including Trinary. While most of the X-Men were sent to a different plane of existence ruled by X-Man, Trinary wasn't one of them. Where she was during his time is unknown. ===House of X=== Trinary eventually returned and was living on the sovereign nation-state of Krakoa for mutants, created by Charles Xavier, Magneto, and Moira X. Moira and Charles Xavier tasked several technopath mutants such as Cypher, Sage, and Trinary with creating a system called "Sleeping Giant" to monitor for Nimrod technological thresholds being reached and/or the attempted creation of a "Mother Mold", a replicating, adaptive Sentinel factory that was self-aware and capable of creating other Sentinels. Xavier and Magneto then tasked the X-Men with destroying the Mother Mold and preventing the creation of Nimrod. With the help of Jean Grey and Monet St. Croix, Trinary coordinated the communication between team members and X-Men base in Krakoa. The X-Men accomplished their goal, but the entire team was killed in the attack thought later resurrected. Trinary remained in Krakoa and aided Magik in tracking down the creators of the anti-Mutant website Dox. Later, Monet St. Croix hired Trinary to be part of the board of the X-Corporation. ===X-Corps=== Trinary was one of the mutants recruited to X-Corps by Mirage following the Mutant Massacre at the Hellfire Gala. With Wiz-Kid, Trinary helped to run X-Corps Island and keep it cloaked from Orchis.

shimata kawa.name: Shimata-Kawa
shimata kawa.origin: Shimata-Kawa was a man of Yamatai, though he was often erroneously referred to as originating from Khitai. As he arrived in Yezud with Ixastophanis, Shimata-Kawa helped Daedikaron and Tros freeing the captured Andamo, Welyn, and Moru. After killing a horde of Demons sent by Tolometh, Shimata-Kawa received a vision to search for the amulet in Aquilonia. Shimata-Kawa found himself in the Aquilonian fort of Venarium in Cimmeria, not long before the Battle of Venarium, where he was accidentally jostled by the young Conan. Blind, he briefly mocked Conan before mysteriously disappearing. Captured and tortured by the Grand Inquisitor of Ong, Shimata-Kawa eventually managed to free himself and Conan, to proceed towards the Desert of Yondo. He reunited there with Daedikaron, Tros, and Welyn He shared an amulet shard together with Conan; with him and the other seekers, he fought a Sand Devil in the Desert of Yondo and entered the Citadel of Sin. He was decapitated by the Patriarch of Tolometh's enchanted blade, although he managed to free its leathery sheath, which Conan used to kill him.

shingen harada ii.name: Shingen Harada II
shingen harada ii.origin: ===Early Life=== Born and raised in Japan, Shingen "Shin" Harada was the illegitimate son of Kenuichio Harada and as such the heir of the Clan Yashida. He was also the boyfriend of Amiko Kobayashi, the foster daughter of Wolverine. ===Hellfire Academy=== At some point, he joined Kade Kilgore's Hellfire Academy, and partnered with Mystique in order to recruit the newly activated mutant Iara Dos Santos, who soon after adopted the code-name Shark-Girl, unsuccessfully, after having battled both their target and Angel. He designed the new Hellfire Academy. thumb|Unmasked ===Confronting Dario Agger=== As CEO of Yashida Corporation, Shingen represented the company at the Universal Bank, where the richest people met to discuss anything relevant to the world. In this meeting, the heads of various companies came from across the globe to confront Dario Agger regarding Roxxon's operations in the Ten Realms, which Agger had kept secret from them. As Agger was unwilling to share the market he had just opened, and threatened anyone who dared to step up and take it from him, Shingen then accepted Agger's offer of taking the new market by force and told Agger this was now a hostile takeover. He then used his resources to sabotage Roxxon's global pipeline, had a spy break into Agger's corporate H.Q. to download a virus, and hacked into his personal cloud where Shingen revealed Agger's tan lines. Shingen then morphed into his Silver Samurai armor and threatened to slice Agger's head off. Just when Agger was about to transform into a minotaur and fight Shingen, Exterminatrix, of the Midas Foundation, arrived and knocked him out cold with 20,000 volts of electricity, and declared herself as the newest member of the group thereafter.
powers: The nanotechnology injected into Shingen allows him to regenerate from fatal wounds. However, it is uncertain if it would allow regeneration of loss limbs or decapitation.

shinji yokohama.name: Shinji Yokohama
shinji yokohama.origin: After the death of her parents, Shinji Yokohama raised his niece Akiko. When Shinji began working as a campaign manager for Ken Takahara, he hired Akiko and made her the campaign speechwriter. Ken was trailing ten points behind Itaru Ozu with no chance of catching up, which caused Shinji to order a hit on Ken through the Bonsai Master. After Ken was killed, Akiko persuaded her uncle to run in Ken's stead, convinced that it was her idea. Akiko soon came to suspect that Ozu was behind Ken's assassinaton. Eventually she accused him of it in public, causing a scandal and forcing Shinji to fire her from the campaign. Shinji eventually won the election and became the new Prime Minister, but learned that Hit-Monkey was coming for him and became overcome with guilt, eventually revealing to Akiko the truth. When the Monkey finally came face to face with Shinji, he was persuaded not to kill him by Bryce. Detective Haruka then tried to arrest Shinji when he grabbed her gun and tried to shoot her. The Monkey had no choice but to kill him, earning Akiko's unending hatred.

shinko yamashiro.name: Shinko Yamashiro
shinko yamashiro.origin: Shinko Yamashiro was the sister of Takuya, the man who would become Spider-Man. She worked with her father Hiroshi and his observatory and witnessed the arrival of Marviller to earth. Amazoness posed as the editor to Hitomi Sakuma and asked her to get in contact with the professor and investigate the Marviller. Hiroshi, Shinko and Hitomi traveled to the crash site of the Marviller and were attacked by Boukunryu. Hiroshi was fatally injured and was found by Takuya and with his dying words, asked Takuya to stop the invaders. After her father's death, Shinko noticed her brother was acting strangely but was uncertain why. Unbeknownst to her, he had taken on the identity of Spider-Man and had began his quest for vengeance against the Iron Cross Army which had killed their father.

shinobu kageyama.name: Shinobu Kageyama
shinobu kageyama.origin: ===Early Life=== Shinobu Kageyama (影山しのぶ, Kageyama Shinobu) lived with his family in Kirisaki City, in the superstate of Hi no Kuni. Born a mutant bestowed with innate telepathic abilities and capable of awakening dormant X-genes in his kind , he showed signs of mental illness from an early age. Inability to control his abilities led to his mother's mental breakdown, driven to insanity by exposure to Kageyama's dark thoughts, which made her attempt to end his life. However, Kageyama was under the protection of an external entity with whom he had formed a personal connection and considered a friend, the Shadow King. Shinobu was eventually inducted into the Children of the Atom, a mutant cult that operated publicly as a religious institution. There, he underwent training to master his abilities and was instilled with a belief in an inherent superiority given to him by his status as a mutant , considered special by the Maester of the cult for his capabilities. In 2022, Kageyama began attending Kirigaya Minami Middle School, where he developed romantic feelings for his classmate, Hisako Ichiki , seeing her as an equal because of her inner struggle to fit in with those around her. He once sneaked uninvited into a game of Kokkuri-san played between Hisako and another classmate, Sayaka, just to get a closer look at her. When Hisako's best friend Tsubasa became increasingly depressed over being the target of bullying, she dropped his gifted Omamori and Kageyama gave it to her in public. She rejected it out of social pressure, hurting Tsubasa's feelings, and a month later, he went to Shinobu for advice. Using his telepathic abilities, Kageyama mentally suggested Tsubasa to commit suicide, which he did. Sometime in 2023, Kageyama attempted to perform a ritual on a cat, who managed to escape outside and subsequently encountered the recent arrival in the neighborhood, Mei Igarashi. Upon Igarashi's return of the cat, Shinobu employed his abilities to provoke the cat into a state of aggression, which led to the cat's violent scratching of Mei. This manifested latent mutant abilities in Mei later that day, which mimicked those of a source of inspiration for her, an African freedom fighter in the Upper and Lower Kingdoms.
powers: X-Gene Activation

shir ydrn talonis.name: Shir Ydrn Talonis
shir ydrn talonis.origin: ===Origin=== Shir Ydrn Talonis, or "Talon", was a sentient Raptor Mechanoid built by the Shi'ar centuries ago. Talon first encountered Darkhawk (Chris Powell) when he crashed into Chris's backyard while on the run from a Hunter Drone that he claimed was sent by those who opposed the work and goals of the Fraternity of Raptors. ===H'jke Jeeku=== Talon's Amulet was found in space by Skrull Commander H'jke Jeeku, one of the Skrull warriors who took part in the Skrull Invasion of Earth. After their defeat Commander Jeeku led his fleet to refuge in the Aranko Nebula. The fleet however was intercepted by the Inhumans and were decimated by Black Bolt's deadly scream. Commander Jeeku was the sole survivor. Moments before his death, he saw a bizarre crystal. Believing his mind was playing tricks on him, he approached this mysterious light, but as soon as he touched it, he was absorbed by the crystal.

shirlee bryant.name: Shirlee Bryant
shirlee bryant.origin: Shirlee Bryant was hired by Malcolm Donalbain to be a spokesmodel for his new chain of health emporiums. She found that although she was hired as "arm candy," he suffered from severe haphephobia (the fear of being touched) so she had to strictly avoid touching him. When he met with Dr. Joanne Tumulo about some research she had done on the motor response at the University of Chicago, looking for some amelioration, she was unable to help. However, he became fascinated with a private experiment she was conducting, to allow any woman to totally fulfill her physical and mental potential, and agreed to subsidize it. When the experiment was ready, he insisted on Shirlee to be its "first lovely guinea pig." Dr. Tumulo had planned to use her lab assistant, Greer Grant, as her first subject. When Dr. Tumulo threatened to cancel the experiment, Greer volunteered to secretly undergo the treatments alongside Shirlee. The experiment exceeded their expectations. Both women emerged with superhuman abilities. thumb|left|100px|Shirlee in the Cat Suit Donalbain had Shirlee use her new eidetic memory to record and duplicate the doctor's equipment. He planned to eliminate the doctor and her assistant once he had his own conditioning machine. He also had further plans for Shirlee: dressed in a cat-like uniform, she was to be the first of an army of enhanced women who would carry out his orders. Although Shirlee objected to the "Hallow'een costume," as she put it, he promised her they'd see eye-to-eye after she'd finished the outfit with a studded choker. The collar was more than merely decorative as it was a "will nullifier" that reduced the wearer to a state of zombie-like obedience. Completely under Donalbain's control, Shirlee followed his orders to climb to the top level of the six-story atrium, using her uniform's claws to dig into the beams. Then he ordered her to cast her claw-hook ahead of her and use it to swing across to the other side. Dr. Tumulo, dissatisfied with Shirlee's results in comparison to Greer's, had determined to end the experiment. She arrived just in time to secretly observe Shirlee fall to her death. It was impossible to tell whether the equipment malfunctioned or if Shirlee's diminished condition led to her failure. However, Donalbain raved that she was incompetent and he would create as many more prototypes as he needed.
weapons: The costume was also outfitted with retractable, case-hardened, steel alloy claws on both the gloves and boots, enabling her to rend brick or stone.

However, he became fascinated with a private experiment she was conducting, to allow any woman to totally fulfill her physical and mental potential, and agreed to subsidize it. When the experiment was ready, he insisted on Shirlee to be its "first lovely guinea pig." Dr. Tumulo had planned to use her lab assistant, Greer Grant, as her first subject. When Dr. Tumulo threatened to cancel the experiment, Greer volunteered to secretly undergo the treatments alongside Shirlee. The experiment exceeded their expectations. Both women emerged with superhuman abilities. thumb|left|100px|Shirlee in the Cat Suit Donalbain had Shirlee use her new eidetic memory to record and duplicate the doctor's equipment. He planned to eliminate the doctor and her assistant once he had his own conditioning machine. He also had further plans for Shirlee: dressed in a cat-like uniform, she was to be the first of an army of enhanced women who would carry out his orders. Although Shirlee objected to the "Hallow'een costume," as she put it, he promised her they'd see eye-to-eye after she'd finished the outfit with a studded choker. The collar was more than merely decorative as it was a "will nullifier" that reduced the wearer to a state of zombie-like obedience. Completely under Donalbain's control, Shirlee followed his orders to climb to the top level of the six-story atrium, using her uniform's claws to dig into the beams. Then he ordered her to cast her claw-hook ahead of her and use it to swing across to the other side. Dr. Tumulo, dissatisfied with Shirlee's results in comparison to Greer's, had determined to end the experiment. She arrived just in time to secretly observe Shirlee fall to her death. It was impossible to tell whether the equipment malfunctioned or if Shirlee's diminished condition led to her failure. However, Donalbain raved that she was incompetent and he would create as many more prototypes as he needed.
transportation: Shirlee could employ her cable-claws, which strapped to her wrists and used four-clawed grappling hooks connected to a 30-foot length of cables, for swinging or tightrope walking.
weapons: The costume was also outfitted with retractable, case-hardened, steel alloy claws on both the gloves and boots, enabling her to rend brick or stone.

shirley booth.name: Shirley Booth
shirley booth.origin: Shirley Booth is the daughter of the newspaper editor that employed Deadline Dawson in the 1940s. She fancied herself a bit of a detective and with her pet parrot Gossip hoped to show up local boy detective Terry Vance. She got the opportunity in the spring of 1943 when Deadline Dawson was assigned by his boss to keep an eye on her. She insisted on meeting Deadline's friend Terry Vance whom she openly mocked and claimed to be the better detective. To try and prove this, she left a note with hidden clues revealing the details of the case she was trying to crack and left it with a challenge to Terry to try and figure it out for himself. She was following local mobster Snake-Eye Smith whom the authorities could not pin any crimes to. She hid herself aboard his yacht hoping to uncover proof about his smuggling operation. Terry managed to trace the clue to Snake-Eye Smith's yacht and with the help of his ape Dr. Watson uncovered that Smith was smuggling ties during a rubber ration due to the War. Snake-Eye Smith was arrested and everyone went home safe, with Shirley not being able to keep out of trouble in the future. Her subsequent activities are unknown, but it seems that she grew out of detective work as she has not interacted with Terry Vance since.

shirley defabio.name: Shirley DeFabio
shirley defabio.origin: Growing up on the mean streets of South Side, Chicago, Shirley learned how to fight from her older brothers. She eventually got a job as Congressman Pug McCuskey's secretary. It was as McCuskey's secretary that she eventually met World War II hero and CIA field officer Nick Fury. She and Fury quickly started an affair, sleeping with each other multiple times a year. McCuskey asked Shirley to marry him, to which she agreed, rationalizing that McCuskey could give her the comfortable lifestyle that she always wanted and Fury could not. She came to despise McCuskey as he would routinely cheat on her with prostitutes, clearly displaying that he did not care about her.

shiro yoshida moira ii 4.name: Shiro Yoshida (Moira-II.4)
shiro yoshida moira ii 4.origin: In a temporal offshoot of Earth-616 designated as Moira-II.4, Abigail Brand successfully saw her plan to start an intergalatic war to completion. However she underestimated and was betrayed by Orbis Stellaris, whose army simultaneously struck Arakko, Krakoa and Earth as a whole. Unprepared, most Avengers perished in the opening salvo, which killed most people on Earth and made the planet uninhabitable by stripping its atmosphere. A small group of Mutants survived by escaping to space on an Acanti-borne Arakko, ironically under the leadership of Brand herself. Sunfire and Redroot were never separated from one another, eventually merging into a single being called Rootfire. Allying with the Starjammers, Brand's X-Men survived for years, occasionally making supply runs to Earth's airless surface. During one such run they rescued and brought with them a group of their long-dead friends - time-traveling X-Men from another timeline. Progidy's power allowed him to absord Brand's memory and quickly bring his group up to speed on her timeline's history. Time-traveling X-Men asked to be brought back to the serface when the Technarchy attacked, send by Stellaris who was after the last mysterium in the universe that was kept by Brand's X-Men. They engaged the intruders in a fight, in which the Starjammers soon arrived to help, while the time-traveling X-Men proceeded with their own mission.

shiv counterfeiter.name: Shiv (Counterfeiter)
shiv counterfeiter.origin: The Shiv was a counterfeiter who was active in the 1940s. He earned his nickname due to his love of knives. By 1945 he and his gang had gotten into counterfeiting ration coupons that were common place during the war. When a FBI agent managed to infiltrate his gang with the help of a stoolie, Shiv soon found out and had both men executed. Their bodies were then placed in bags filled with books and dumped in a nearby alley. The bags were discovered by the Young Allies while they were on a scrap paper drive. Seeing the boys taking the body bags, Shiv and his gang tried to stop them but were held back by Toro's flame while the Allies escaped. When the Young Allies realized what they had, they then set up a trap for Shiv and his gang. With Bucky and Toro hiding in the sacks, the other Young Allies brought them back to the alley where they were found. Spotting the kids again, Shiv and his gang captured them and brought them back to their base where they revealed their operation. But, before they could kill the Young Allies, Bucky and Toro revealed themselves and the youths easily rounded up Shiv and his gang and turned them over to the authorities. Shiv's subsequent fate is unknown.

shiv gangster.name: Shiv (Gangster)
shiv gangster.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 67: Wolverine: Bloody Choices
shiv gangster.origin: A mercenary who worked for drug-dealer Mr. Bullfinch. In the line of his work, he found himself confronted with Wolverine in a couple of fights, surprising the Canadian mutant with speed, stamina and strength comparable to his own. thumb|200px|left|Shiv extracts his "claws" in front of Wolverine It is not clear if any degree of superhuman abilities was involved, but Shiv has been able to lift with a single arm the 300 lbs heavy body of Wolverine. Besides the surprising resemblance between the two - only comparable to that shared with Sabretooth or Romulus - Shiv and Wolverine had apparently already met, though they both could not remember on which occasion. After having stated that he's a fast healer as Wolverine, Shiv has his head crashed through a concrete wall of a swimming-pool, emerging severely beaten but not unconscious. After that, he bargained his freedom in exchange for a tip-off on his boss's hideout. Since then, Shiv hasn't been seen anymore.
abilities: Shiv is proficient in the use of small bladed weapons and can knives with great accuracy and speed.
weapons: Shiv carries knives. He also appears to wear two wrists-mounted single retractable blades, working in a similar way than Wolverine's claws.
