shocket raccoon.name: Shocket Raccoon
shocket raccoon.species: Halfworlder Mutate female Clone of Rocket Raccoon
shocket raccoon.origin: Shocket was created by the Collector from genetic material of Rocket Raccoon, a prisoner of his collection, for reproductive purposes. When Rocket Raccoon and another inmate named Howard the Duck escaped, Shocket and Howard's clone Linda were put under the care of Gatherer D-3X until the escapees were recovered. Six months went by, and the Collector wasn't able to recover neither Rocket nor Howard, so Shocket and Linda were to be put in cryogenic stasis. D-3X had grown fond of both of them, so he rebelled against the Collector's mandate and escaped along with the kids. Three months later, Shocket, Linda and D-3X arrived to the planet Souqlon and, with the help of a rebel Space Phantom known as Multo, they escaped to the furthest they could go into the past, twenty-five years. Twenty years after their arrival to the past, the three fugitives had become smugglers. While they were conducting business, one of their clients recognized D-3X as the person who had kidnapped their parents, unaware that it had actually been his past/present self, and blasted him with a gun. Shocket, Linda, and D-3X escaped from their attackers, but D-3X's wounds were fatal, and he died subsequently. Five years later, the time for the escape of their present selves to the past was looming, meaning the Collector would start looking for them. Both both Shocket and Linda knew they couldn't keep going back in time, they needed to leave the universe. With the help of the Oracle of Omega, they were directed to the Nexus of All Realities.

shocks marley.origin: Shocks Marley, a stock car stunt driver and convicted murderer (he killed Ned Pearson). He wore a costume made by a witch woman from Haiti while being executed, and this turned him into the Apparition. As the Apparition, he attacked Johnny Blaze (mistaking him for Pete Catrones). Later he again attacked Blaze, along with Nora and Sonny Tremont, but Ghost Rider chased him off. Blaze was next attacked while riding in Sonny Tremont's car. The Apparition then left, thinking Sonny was dead. Then, while Blaze was busy elsewhere, the Apparition attacked and killed Nora. Discovering this, Ghost Rider attacked him and through liberal doses of hellfire caused the Apparition to dissipate into thin air.

shoji soma.name: Shoji Soma
shoji soma.origin: left|thumb|250px|The Zodiac (Great Wheel) (Earth-616)|Great Wheel In 1961, the Hand Grandmaster Shoji Soma was contacted by the Brotherhood of the Shield and was brought to the Immortal City to meet with Leonardo da Vinci in Pieta. Along with other intelligence agents from around the globe—Jake Fury, Magadan, John Garrett, Cornelius van Lunt, Nick Fury, Baron Strucker, Dum Dum Dugan, Thomas Davidson, the Kraken, and Orion—they formed the Great Wheel. Each member was assigned a codename from the zodiac, Soma being Pisces. Leonardo da Vinci was the leader as Aries, sent the rest of the Wheel on three key retrieval missions, and promised them resources that would be of great value to their own separate agendas. Shoji Soma took part in an operation along with John Garrett, Kraken and Magadan, infiltrated an ancient Brood vessel in Giza, Egypt, killed the Brood host and acquired a power source. The Great Wheel later fell apart due to the betrayal of Orion and Magadan of Leviathan. Shoji Soma and Baron Strucker united to attack Leviathan and severely wounded Orion; Magadan rushed Orion into stasis, but the superhuman process could not be carried out after Hydra and the Hand had stolen the Brood power source. Shoji Soma met with Lord Shigen and the Silver Samurai of Clan Yashida at Agarashima, and Soma hid the alien power source vital towards the revival of Leviathan inside a Yashida ancestral box. Despite Shigen's warning that no one who has opened the box has lived to see it closed, Soma knew that he was already dead. The next day, Magadan attempted to retrieve the power source in order to revive Orion, killing Shoji Soma in his search, but could not find it. Magadan and Leviathan went dark for many years.
abilities: Shoji Soma had katana fencing skills.

shola inkosi.name: Shola Inkosi

shooter female.name: Shooter (Female)
shooter female.origin: Shooter was a member of Geronimo Crowe's resistance group who was task to fight against the Administrator and his Watchtower. She helped rescue Wolverine after he had been captured by Deadpool and the Administrator's team the Scourge. Shooter engaged the Administrator's personal guard in battle by using an energy weapon built within her cybernetic arm. Once they took care of the "goon squad", she wanted to finish off Deadpool even though his reason for helping the Administrator was to heal the mutant Siryn who laid in suspended animation inside a stasis tube. Shooter got trigger happy and fired a blast that hit Deadpool in the head while knocking the tube to the ground. This caused Siryn to wake up while she used her voice to crack the glass open thus releasing her from the pod. Shooter became bewildered by Theresa's sonic voice asking if this was normal. Wolverine conveyed that that the return of her mutant abilities was a minor miracle. After a brief discussion between Theresa and Logan, Shooter went along with her team to another Watchtower safehouse but after taking out one of the guards they found out the Administrator was only here as a projected hologram leading them to another dead end.
powers: Could fire beams of energy

short circuit.name: Short Circuit
short circuit.origin: Short Circuit was a grandchild of Lilith, and thus part-demon himself. On learning of his ancestry, he became determined to earn her favor, and murdered at least fourteen boys as offerings to her. He was eventually captured, imprisoned, and sentenced to death. As he was placed in the electric chair, his demonic powers finally became active, absorbing the electricity and giving him the ability to create portals into other worlds. Now immensely powerful, he took over the prison, killing most of the staff and guards and freeing his fellow prisoners. Using his powers, he transported many people into other worlds, driving many of them insane. When the Nightstalkers came to investigate reports of strange occurrences at the prison, he attacked them, throwing Hannibal King into an alternate dimension. When Frank Drake tried to use an electrical gun against him, he absorbed the energy, becoming even more powerful. Eventually, the remaining Nightstalkers were able to find and rescue Hannibal King, and realizing that Short Circuit needed to absorb electricity to power his abilities, they shut down the prison's power systems. Without an external source of electricity, Short Circuit's powers consumed his own energy, reducing him to a pile of ash.
powers: Short Circuit has the ability to absorb electricity and surround himself with a protective electrical aura. : He could use his energy to .
weaknesses: Electricity Dependency: Short Circuit required an external source of electricity to power his abilities. Without it, his powers would consume his own energy.

shortpack.name: Shortpack
shortpack.origin: The mutant known as Shortpack is the nephew of now-deceased FBI agent and mutant-sympathizer Fred Duncan. If not for the meditative exercises he learned from Professor Charles Xavier, he likely would have shrunk to a microscopic size. Unfortunately for him, he cannot control his power to grow or shrink any further, and so he remains about 8 inches tall. Shortpack was recruited by Professor Xavier to be a field handler for the clandestine operatives in his employ. Shortpack's first agent was Prudence (Agent 16), who was seemingly killed by the arms dealer Steinbeck. The next agent to be assigned to him was the former mutant terrorist/freedom fighter, Mystique, but when the two met in Cuba for the first time, Shortpack did not know about her terrorist background. After handling Mystique on a few missions, Shortpack was contacted by the Quiet Man, who offered him a way to exact vengeance on Steinbeck for killing Prudence. He tried to get Fantomex to kill Steinbeck for him, but was refused, though Fantomex brought him to what he thought was Steinbeck's lair. Instead, Shortpack found that his target was his benefactor - the Quiet Man - was Prudence's mind in Steinbeck's body, and the exchange had driven her mad. S/he captured Shortpack and used him as bait for Mystique, who had replaced her. Shortpack was eventually rescued by Mystique, and presumably still works for Xavier.
powers: Short-range : Shortpack has the power to shrink down to eight inches tall.
abilities: An organizational god, a master of Microsoft word, and net surfing guru. Possesses knowledge of foreign cities that far exceeds usefulness. Separate from these mental disciplines, Shortpack is also a trained operative
possessing surprising athleticism and marksmanship for someone of his size.
weapons: Forge-designed handguns that only fire non-lethal stun darts. He also bites pretty hard.

shorty harris.name: Shorty Harris
shorty harris.origin: Assigned by his editor to investigate those who supplied weapons to indigenous people in the Congo, Shorty Harris traveled to Africa. During the investigation he discovered that a group of hunters intended to capture a large anthropomorphic ape with four arms. Being an animal lover, Shorty ran to the Beast's aid and saved him from capture. Soon after he was captured by the natives and held prisoner in their village to hand him over to the hunter who sold him weapons, the same hunter who wanted to capture the Beast. Recognizing Shorty as the one who had prevented the capture of the Beast, he ordered the natives to eliminate him, but the Beast came to Shorty's aid, who revealed himself to be a powerful alien looking for a human worthy of hearing his message. As a gesture of goodwill to other species all zoos on Earth were shut down.

shower.name: Shower
shower.species: Artificial being created by Mojo by using Neoplasm to resemble the Storm from X-Men.
shower.origin: Shower was one of the X-Babies created by Mojo from neoplasm to replace the original X-Men, whose death had caused a drop in ratings. Mojo was going to destroy them, but the X-Babies escaped alongside Mojo's pilot, Ricochet Rita. The group fled in Mojo's Crossover House and in the ensuing battle with Mojo's forces, escaped into Earth-616, with Rita being captured in the process and secretly converted into "The Agent" and sent after them. The group discovered Kitty Pryde on a train and upon startling her awake, Kitty phased out of the train. The group then had to return Excalibur but had no forms of communication and were being pursued by the Agent, who captured several of the X-Babies by tricking them into signing contracts. The captured were freed when Kitty removed the signatures from the contracts. They captured the Agent during a fight between him and the X-Babies and Excalibur and Phoenix restored Rita. The X-Babies agreed to return to Mojo if he gave Rita her freedom. Shower and the X-Babies returned to Mojoworld alongside Rita as their guardian and had a list of demands that Mojo had to meet for them to return to work. After Mojo was usurped by Longshot and Dazzler, Gog and MaGog set out to kill the X-Babies. Shower and several others fled to Earth-616 and sought help from Phoenix and Iceman who protected the X-Babies until Dazzler arrived and ordered the pair to stand down. She allowed the X-Babies to come and lives in the royal palace for their protection. Shower was one of the X-Babies who helped Wolverine defeat the Warwolves disguised as his teammates and enemies that Mojo II was using to help return the Mojoverse to its television watching state. Some time after this, the X-Babies constructed the Clubhouse for Gifted Youngsters in the Umbrella Forest and were lead by Charlie X who was considered their "Big Brother". Here, the X-Babies tried to save the Pix from the Brotherhood of Mutant Bullies. Failing in their mission the X-Babies returned to their base, only to be attacked and captured by Centennials (Parade balloons turned into Sentinels). The X-Babies were forced to take part in a game show designed by Funhouse (an Evil Baby version of Arcade), which included both quiz and deathtraps. The group failed at the quiz sections but were able to beat the traps and were eventually freed by Cyke and Locksteed. Funhouse threatened to turn the Brotherhood back into neoplasm if the X-Babies did not return and they were about to agree to this when Charlie X showed up with reinforcements and saved the X-Babies.

shredder.name: Shredder
shredder.origin: Shredder was a killer for hire who enjoyed torturing others. He fought Wolverine years ago and nearly killed him. When drug dealers Sid and Whitie two-timed him, Harry Gavino hired the Shredder to go after them. Sid and Whitie, having survived after the plane they were flying on crashed in the Canadian wilderness. Shredder later learned that Sid Whitie from an elderly couple that the criminals had stolen a motorhome from them. Shredded thanked the couple by killing them. Whitie, while driving the motorhome, crashed it after one of his hostages attacked him. Whitie's back was broken and left behind by Sid. Shredder found Whitie and killed him after getting the info he needed. Shredder eventually found Sid at Lake Vague and killed him. One of Sid's hostages told him of a safe that she could open if she let the other hostage, her son, live. Shredded agreed and took a boat out onto Lake Vague. During Shredder's mission, he was being tracked by Wolverine and the Hulk. When Shredder tossed one of the hostages into the water, Wolverine asked Hulk to save the hostage while he went after Shredder. Wolverine boarded Shredder's boat and battled him, eventually crashing the boat on dry land. Shredder badly hurt Wolverine while he was stunned, but Wolverine sliced his right arm off and left him to be eaten by a mountain lion. Shredder later appeared as one of the many souls in Hell that Marduk Kurios sent to fight Wolverine.
powers: Shredder's claws are capable of easily rending flesh and impaling people.
abilities: Shredder is an expert tracker.

shrub.name: Shrub
shrub.origin: Shrub works with his partner Pockets Possum as couriers. One day Groot hired Pockets Postal to deliver him to Lord Rakzoon. Upon making the delivery, Pockets and Shrub were accused of being thieves and thrown in Lord Rakzoon's torture dungeon. After making a deal with the imprisoned former dictator of the planet, High Ruler Nosaj, both Pockets and Shrub tried to have Rocket and Groot killed; however, their plan backfired after their squabbling caused Nosaj to decided to have all four killed instead. The quartet escaped the palace, but Pockets still held resentment towards Rocket for imprisoning them, and almost getting them killed. Rocket responded by stealing Pockets' ship, leaving Pockets and Shrub stranded, for which the possum vowed revenge against Rocket.

shu hu android.name: Shu-Hu (Android)
shu hu android.origin: When Shu-Hu, The One, refused to deliberately lose his match in the Challenge of The One, which was intended to prove Orson Randall, son of Phineas Randall, worthy of the title of Iron Fist, Yu-Ti replaced him with a mechanical being that would obey without question. This android went on to face Danny Rand after he defeated Shou-Lao and gained the power of the Iron Fist. However, The One was programmed by Yu-Ti to lose this fight. As such, Danny defeated The One, revealing it to be an android in the process. This victory "proved" that Danny was worthy of the title of Iron Fist, and also won him the right to consume the fruit of immortality from the Tree of Immortality, which he refused. The One's body was taken out of K'un-Lun, since technology was not allowed in the city, and thrown into a deep crevasse. There, it bonded to the dormant body of Wendell Rand and took his head. It then absorbed his memories and believed itself to be Wendell, becoming obsessed with resurrecting Heather Rand, Wendell's wife. First, he got revenge on K'un Lun for abandoning him. He burned down the city and killed many people, including the Yu-Ti, and an incarnation of Shou-Lao. When Iron Fist discovered this, he went after The One and discovered that the android wore his father's face and had also stolen the faces of the Thunderer and Harold Meachum. The One used Danny's rage to distract him and shattered his wrists. He then attempted to integrate Danny, but Danny was saved by an avalanche. After this, he set out to kill the last incarnation of Shou Lao, which was with a girl named Pei, and use its energy to power the Randall Gate, still trying to open a portal to the Diyu to save Heather's soul. While he battled and nearly killed Iron Fist, his ally, Davos killed Gork, the reborn Shou-Lao. However, the plan failed and the Xian god of fire, Zhu Rong arrived, claiming The One had upset the cosmic balance and that the whole city would be destroyed in retribution. He then attacked The One and proceeded to begin destroying the city. Iron Fist then bonded to The One, as both of them were dying. Since The One had wired itself into Rand Tower, the whole tower came to life. Unfortunately, even this was not enough to defeat Zhu Rong, so The One gave up its chi and soul to power Danny so that he could use all his chi at once and fly through Zhu Rong, killing the god.
powers: Android Physiology:

shuffler.name: Shuffler
shuffler.origin: The Shuffler was a gambler who lived in the town of Red Dog, Texas during the days of the Golden Egg Gambling Palace. His operation was run out of the Frontier Saloon along with his partners Ace and Dawson. Eventually, the Shuffler and Dawson sought to cut Ace out of their enterprise and plotted to kill him. The opportunity came to them one night when Ace humiliated local drunk Jem Hartley and threw him out of the Frontier Saloon, this altercation ending with Jem threatening to kill Ace. The Shuffler then had Dawson sneak up behind Ace one night and shoot him dead. When Ace's body was discovered, the murder was investigated by sheriff Blaze Carson. Both the Shuffler and Dawson blamed Jem of murdering their partner, recalling the threat from the night before. However, Dawson let slip that Ace was shot with a .44. As Blaze investigated the evidence was looking to stack up against Jem Hartley who surrendered to the law. Meanwhile, the Shuffler and Dawson were working up the locals into a lynch mob in the hopes of getting Jem killed by a mob so they can avoid implication in the murder. However, Blaze kept Jem safe until they got into the sheriff's office. There they were informed by the doctor that the autopsy on Ace was completed and that the bullets that killed him fire clean through his body and were smashed flat, eliminating any sort of way to identify the calibre of the bullets. Remembering that Dawson had told him that they were .44 rounds, Blaze correctly deduced who the real killers were. By this point, the, Shuffler was leading a lynch mob to the sheriff's office. The mob stood down when Blaze and the Doc appeared with guns. Jem then accused Dawson of killing Ace and framing him. When Dawson denied the allegations, Jem became enraged and began beating on Dawson who surrendered and confessed to the crime. Dawson and the Shuffler were then arrested and locked in jail. The Shuffler's subsequent fate is unknown.
abilities: The Shuffler was a professional gambler.

shuten doji.name: Shuten Döji
shuten doji.origin: Shuten Döji was a former member of The Hand who broke out on his own. He established a base of operations in Bagalia, built himself an army of ninja, and started amassing high-tech arsenal. Shuten's enemies put a contract out on him, and the assingment was taken by Deadpool. Deadpool initially joined a group of mercenaries that had taken the job and approached Shuten Döji's castle on a plane. Their presence was detected by Shuten, and he ordered his men to take it down. After killing the mercenaries since there was also a hit on their head, Deadpool launched their corpses on jetpacks on Shuten Döji's castle as a distraction. By the time Deadpool landed and started slaughtering Shuten's army of monks and ninja, the warlord had already retreated. After killing Shuten's army, Deadpool delved deeper into the castle and was confronted by Shuten himself, who appeared to have had grafted into his body mechanical arms similar to Doctor Octopus' Tentacles. Shuten Döji rapidly constricted Deadpool and pulled him up close. However, Deadpool had stolen a glove that mimicked Iron Fist's powers from one of Shuten's ninja, and punched Shuten Döji on the face with it, which blew off his entire head.

siapep.name: Siapep
siapep.origin: ===Origins=== Siapep was the spawn of the Elder God Set, and the sibling of the Dragon of the Moon, Sligguth, Damballah, Yamata no Orochi, Tartessus, and Ishiti. Siapep the Devourer was associated with the Egyptian gods. It was a servant to the Death god Seth and obeyed his commands. ===Modern Age=== In the modern age, Seth sought revenge against his brother Osiris and the Asgardian thunder god Thor. After capturing Osiris, Seth then went to Earth and captured Thor, taking the Fantastic Four's Thing along with the thunder god to Celestial Heliopolis to battle on the Golden Path of the Gods. In the ensuing battle Seth summoned the Devourer and set it upon the two heroes. The creature was nearly indestructible but was defeated when the Thing pushed off it the Golden Path into the dimensional void below where it has presumably been lost ever since.
powers: The Devourer appeared to be invulnerable to any sort of harm.

sibarthu.name: Sibarthu
sibarthu.origin: Sibarthu was a gigantic bat-lizard entity positioned as an idol and guardian at the Mountain-Temple of God Zokk. The creature remained dormant for centuries until it was awakened by Klonus the Wizard. Klonus used Sibarthu as both a flying mount and an ally during his assault on Citrusville. After teleporting there with Mortak, Klonus forced Dakimh, Jennifer Kale, Korrek, and Man-Thing into battle. While Klonus fought Dakhim and Mortak confronted Korrek, Sibarthu attacked Man-Thing directly. During the struggle, Man-Thing used a roadside sign to decapitate the creature. Upon touching the ground, Sibarthu’s severed head reverted to its original stone form, causing the entire monster to collapse into lifeless rubble.

sibylla.name: Sibylla
sibylla.origin: From a young age, Sibylla possessed the power to see into the future. So, she became an oracle for the temple of Apollo and Artemis and acted as a deliverer for their messages to mortals. When Sibylla was about to succumb to old age, Apollo offered godhood, but she rejected the offer so she her spirit could remain in the temple and act as a guide for her successors. When the Roman Empire of an alternate reality conquered the galaxy but ran out of enemies, the mad wizard Xennus decided to use the temple of Mt. Gaurus as a pathway into other realities for the Roman Empire to conquer. To stop Xennus, Sibylla asked Doctor Strange and Clea for their help. Clea, Sibylla, and the spirit of the oracle Thaleia worked together to close the portal and send Xennus back to his home reality. With her job done, Sibylla's body crumbled away, and the temple collapsed. Sibylla later reappeared on Earth-616 and somehow became head of the Federal Reserve. When Kang the Conqueror began killing off the Avengers by killing them as babies, Hercules asked for her help. Sibylla gave Hercules her amulet, which he and Avengers could use to protect themselves from Kang's meddling of the timeline.
powers: Sibylla possesses the power to see into the future. She also possessed certain magic powers.

sickle moon.name: Sickle Moon
sickle moon.origin: A ruthless hitman who was assigned to kill Nate McBride by The Cheese, but the crimelord was punished by Foolkiller. So, he killed Nate without payment before learning of his employers death. A year later, the racist gang the White Angels called him to kill Punisher as they were being hunted by him and Foolkiller, and wanted to kill Foolkiller themselves. On the plane from New York to Los Angeles, he killed a selfish fat woman who was seated near him. He almost killed the Punisher with his crescent shaped blades before his arm was slashed off by Foolkiller. He then fell off the bridge into the river with both vigilantes thinking he was dead. He survived the fall, went home and promised revenge on Foolkiller while attaching his new mechanical arm and trying it by killing a cat.

sico rudo.name: Sico Rudo
sico rudo.origin: Professor Sico Rudo was a Imperial Japanese scientist who was active during World War II. By the summer of 1945, he developed a weapon for the Japanese he called "Atom Water", a liquid that when evaporated caused a powerful explosion. To test it out, he and a group of Japanese soldiers used it on a Japanese island that recently was captured by the Americans, with each sample going off in areas that the military were clearing. The blasts prompted Captain America and Bucky to investigate it further. Following the trail of explosions to the cave where Rudo and his men were hiding out, Cap and Bucky were captured. Rudo then left them tied up in the sun surrounded by Atom Water and left a sample vial behind to mock them while they went to cause more destruction. Breaking free, Cap tossed the sample vial into Rudo's cave. Tracking down Rudo and his men, Cap and Bucky attacked. With his men losing the battle, Rudo shot his own men and fled back to his cave. When Cap and Bucky failed to follow them, he accused them of being cowards just moments before the broken vial of Atom Water exploded, killing him instantly. Recovering a sample of Atom Water from one of the dead soldiers, Cap turned it over to the military where he was informed America had developed a more powerful weapon: The Atom Bomb.
weapons: Rudo was armed with a pistol. He also invented "Atom Water", a highly explosive liquid that would explode when evaporated by the sun.

sid ridley.name: Sid Ridley
sid ridley.species: Human enhanced by a variant of the Super-Soldier Serum
sid ridley.origin: "Rambling" Sid Ridley, as Captain Midlands, is the British equivalent of Captain America. The British Super Soldier program of the early 1940s increased his strength, stamina, and agility to the peak of human capacity. This allowed him to fight as a British Super Soldier during World War II. Captain Midlands, unlike Captain America, was not frozen in ice and aged normally. Captain Midlands is now in his 80s but he still has his superhuman abilities but has the aged body of a pensioner. Much of Sid Ridley's life remains a mystery but he did marry Nancy Ridley who died in 1963. This was Captain Midland's greatest loss and when offered his heart's desire by the Duke of Hell known as Plokta, his wish was to live happily with her. Through unrevealed circumstances, Sid Ridley came to serve with the British intelligence agency MI13. During the missions that have been seen, he's mainly served as a background character, battling fairies in Fairy Hillfort, trying to save citizens from the waking Pantagruel, being drained of energy by Ddraig Goch and falling asleep, and helping slaughter extra-dimensional Jack the Ripper. After the Skrull invasion of Earth, Captain Midlands spent his time protecting the citizens of the United Kingdom from drug smugglers and other such more mundane criminals. During one of the drug busts on the Cloverleaf Estate in Hodge Hill, Birmingham he found Plokta, the Duke of Hell's secret base, which he has set up for his plans taking over the planet. Captain Midlands battled the Mindless Ones but due to the number he was forced to surrender. He sent out a distress call to MI13 team bringing them to Plokta's base to save him. When they found Captain Midlands he tricked them into entering the dream corridor which trapped them and used their magical energies to create more Mindless Ones to attack Earth. Captain Midlands was working for the Duke of Hell since he was captured and offered his heart's desire; his long dead wife Nancy. Pete Wisdom destroyed Captain Midlands' fantasy and MI13 escaped from the dream corridor to defeat Plokta. Captain Midlands was taken away and declared a traitor to the crown and put in the Vault, a high security prison in Shoreditch, to await trial. Before the trial, Pete Wisdom visited Captain Midlands in his cell and gave him a gun so that he could shoot himself rather than go through a trial for treason. Though whether or not he took this oppurtunity is left ambiguous.

sidney abel.name: Sidney Abel
sidney abel.origin: thumb|left|150px|Sidney after the transformationSidney Abel was a simple person but physically small to the point of not even being accepted into the Army, so he started working in a laboratory that carried out research for the Army and he in particular took care of the guinea pigs they used for their experiments. When he had to place guinea pigs on an island where they would detonate a nuclear warhead, he decided to stay on the island since his life had little meaning. However, he did not die with the bomb explosion but received a high dose of radiation that modified his DNA and physically transformed him, making him a tall and muscular man, the one he had always dreamed of. Escaping from the research center, Sidney returned to his city to first meet his best friend Bill, who was afraid of him as he was contaminated, and then he went to Nancy's house, the girl with whom Sidney was in love but to whom he had never declared himself due to his physical appearance. Nancy chased him away, telling him that she didn't recognize him as Sidney, who she remembered as a sweet and kind person while he was a monster. She also told him that her parents had both died from shock upon hearing the news of what had happened to him. Rejected by everyone, at that point Sidney decided to retreat to the contaminated island in the company of the only beings who would accept him, his guinea pigs.

sidney crumb.name: Sidney Crumb
sidney crumb.origin: thumb|left|175px Sid Crumb was a poor boy in his early life which he was beaten on by bullies and had to deal with a drunk father at home. In his later years, he was married and spent most of his time drinking, at one point his wife Mavis had left him. Then one day he heard a strange noise which lead him to the Fury defeated by Captain Britain which it had sent a dart attack accurately killing one of his neighbors to regenerate. As he ran, it sent a dart attack at him only hitting him in the arm in which the narrator says "such good fortune could never be Sid's", the dart was laced with a poison that slowly mutated him. He was slightly aware of the transformation thinking he was sick but wasn't completely. Later, he was in the rain as the mutation slowly took over. He then went over to some kids cutting school in hopes of finding help, but he had a flashback about the bullies and blindly dissolved them. As he continued, the mutation caused him to grow while his body seemed to already be dead. As he moved onward, the mutation caused his fingers to change: one became a tentacle, two stayed the same, one was a big mound of rotting flesh, and one was a normal human arm. While he changed, he lost his clothes and his mouth. thumb|200px|left Soon, he had a flashback about his drunken father and Mavis thinking "You've could've stayed!" while he decided to "show her". He went to a pharmacy to get tablets, but then realized his mouth was gone and he thought loudly "WHERE"S MY MOUTH?!" While he did this, he picked up two people dissolving them to look for his mouth, and Captain Britain came and fought him. While Sid recognized him, he flashed back to the Fury that had caused the accident and hit Captain Britain thinking nobody cared for him. As Captain Britain hit him back, it started to hurt him until he screamed in his mind "PLEASE STOP HURTING ME!!" and Captain Britain felt it as he slowly dissolved away.
weaknesses: He can't fully control his power to dissolve things and was delirious.

sidney joern.name: Sidney Joern
sidney joern.origin: Dr. Sidney Joern was a brilliant but unethical scientist and the chief psychic surgeon of a clandestine organization known as the Project, which specialized in illegal psychic surgery performed on unwilling subjects. Under Joern’s direction, the Project sought to control, suppress, or weaponize individuals with extraordinary mental abilities. Joern played a central role in the manipulation and abuse of Mary Walker, later known as Typhoid Mary, whose mutant powers attracted the Project’s attention. Mary was abducted and subjected to repeated psychic experimentation, exacerbating her dissociative identity disorder. When Mary later attempted to force Joern to use psychic surgery to eliminate her violent personalities, Joern instead attempted to kill her during the procedure. The operation was interrupted by Wolverine, leading to a violent confrontation in which Joern shot one of his own assistants and attempted to murder both Mary and Wolverine. Wolverine ultimately decapitated Joern. Despite this, the Project preserved Joern’s severed head, sustaining his consciousness in a nutrient bath. Following these events, the Project was reorganized and renamed Fortress.

The real Sidney Levine was replaced behind the scenes, and his LMD became active when Nick Fury directed a mission to obtain the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier's Power Core in the deserts of New Mexico; Levine contacted Hydra, which arrived to battle S.H.I.E.L.D. in order to take the Core for theirselves. The Gaffer's LMD partecipated at Clay Quartermain's funeral. Levine was later revealed to be part of S.H.I.E.L.D. and Roxxon's Project: Delta, the program that replaced agents with LMDs. When the S.H.I.E.L.D. Space Station exploded, all the LMDs were destroyed, including Gaffer's LMD.

sidney onselm.name: Sidney Onselm
sidney onselm.origin: The origins of the Brain are unknown, his namesake comes from the fact that he has a massive head. By 1947 he was a leader of his own gang and a regular accomplice of another criminal known only as the Knife. In the summer of that year he and his gang plotted to steal a shipment of Ambergris that was being brought into the United States aboard a ship piloted by Captain Cole. Their intent was to sell the stolen merchandise to perfume manufacturers and make a massive profit. After plotting their caper, the Brain and his men went to their secondary hideout located on Taboo Island to meet up with the knife. They arrived just as the Sub-Mariner and Namora had finished subduing the Knife after stumbling upon him on the island. The Brain took Namora hostage at gun point and forced Namor to stand down. They then tied up the two heroes and were about to kill them when one of the Brain's men informed them that Cole's ship was approaching. The Brian and the Knife were forced to deal with the heroes later while they left to steal the Ambergris. However, Namor and Namora managed to break free of their bonds and track the Brain and his men to Captain Cole's ship where they quickly subdued them and turned them over to the authorities. The subsequent fate of the Brain is unknown.

sidney sarnak.name: Sidney Sarnak
sidney sarnak.origin: The man now known only as Sarnak was once one of the greatest sound engineers in the recording business and was considered a legend in his profession. This all came toppling down, however, when he was exposed as being involved in an illegal bootlegging operation of popular albums. While attempting to escape, Sarnak was injured and supposedly scarred for life. From this time on, Sarnak took to wearing a green emerald mask to hide his features. He spent his months recovering studying sound and created a device which he called his Control Whistle which gave him the power to control people's minds by reaching into the vibrational pattern of the human and animal brain. Sarnak agreed to use this new device in the service of the Committee, and created his Legion of Fear out of homeless derelicts to obey his every command. The Committee wanted Sarnak to capture Jack Russell and his sister Lissa having learned of their curse of lycanthropy. The Committee had a secret interest in werewolves and harnessing their power, but they simply told Sarnak to use them to create terror which would in turn supposedly speed up the country's economy as people sought to protect themselves. In his first attempt to capture the Werewolf, Sarnak sent one of his Legion of Fear members, the man who would later come to be known as Tatterdemalion, to subdue him. After the two strange combatants fought to a standstill, Sarnak had Tatterdemalion retreat, but the supersonic sound of his whistle was incredibly painful to the Werewolf and caused him to lose consciousness. When he awoke, Jack found himself in jail and was subsequently bailed out by his step-father. That night, the rest of the Legion of Fear descended upon the Russell household. After a fight with the Werewolf, Sarnak's whistle again caused him to lose consciousness and the strange horde took their prize to Sarnak's secret hideout in the sewers below Los Angeles. Sarnak then used the whistle to cause the Werewolf to join his Legion and run amok in the Century City part of Los Angeles. The Werewolf attacked several innocent people before seeing his sister, Lissa, and regaining some of his memory. Sarnak, however, then captured Lissa as well before the Werewolf could protect her, and they were all returned to his secret liar. After transforming back into Jack, he escaped from Sarnak's clutches, vowing to return to free his sister after getting help. He returned to Buck Cowen's and got him to contact a friend who is a sound engineer. The man provides Jack with a sonic screen which will nullify sounds in the upper frequencies that can be strapped to his arm. After the sun went down, the Werewolf once again returned to Sarnak's hideout and attacked his Legion. After defeating his men, Sarnak tried to use the control whistle on the beast, but to no effect, thanks to the sonic screen. The Werewolf then easily defeated Sarnak and rescued Lissa while the mind control effects began to wear off the rest of the Legion of Fear. Coming to their senses, the men overwhelmed Sarnak, vowing to make him pay for what he had done to them. Years later, Sarnak came into a conflict with Moon Knight and his Midnight Mission allies while testing records inducing a berserk-like state on a rave. He was almost caught by Reese but managed to escape with the help of his henchmen.
powers: None.

siegfried kunz.name: Siegfried Kunz
siegfried kunz.origin: thumb|left|119px|Siegfriend Kunz posing as a flower woman. Siegfried Kunz was a spy for the Nazis who was active during World War II. By 1944 he and a group of spies were located in New York City. Learning that German-American actress Ingrid Ilsen was close to high ranking members of the American military Kunz and his men attempted to pressure her into spying for them. When she refused, Kunz then decided to eliminate her. Posing as a flower woman, Kunz sold her an orchid that was laced with a poison that killed her. Her sudden death was witnessed by the Angel, who recognized the orchid as being similar to one he had just purchased earlier from the same flower woman. Spotting her ducking into a car, the Angel hitched a ride on the back of the vehicle back to Kunz's hideout. There the Angel attempted to apprehend Kunz and his spies but was knocked out and tied up. Coming around, the Angel learned why Kunz had murdered the actress. To dispose of the hero, Kunz placed a time bomb and set it for five minutes. However, the Angel was followed to the hideout by the police, necessitating Kunz and his men to attempt to escape through the secret exit tunnel. Able to disarm the bomb, the Angel was then untied by the police and went after Kunz and his men. As the Angle clashed with Kunz and his men, Kunz attempted to kill the hero by shooting at a gas main hoping to burn the hero alive. The plan backfired when the jet of flame engulfed Kunz instead.
weapons: Kunz was armed with a pistol and had access to explosives to make time bombs.

sigmund adler.name: Sigmund Adler
sigmund adler.origin: Doctor Sigmund Adler was a criminal psychologist who was active during the 1940s. In 1940 he was asked to do a speech for the Lee School by teachers Jeff Mace and Betsy Ross (secretly Captain America and Golden Girl) when he witnessed a robbery. Captain America and Golden Girl captured the robber who was revealed to be one John Dolan, whose face became more deformed as a psychological effect of committing crimes. Adler agreed to treat the man and using a technique of hypnosis he developed, transported his mind and those of Captain America and Golden Girl into John's brain in order to discover the cause of his mental problems. Although the trio were impeded by John's evil self, they learned the John's psychosis was caused by two defining events: The feelings of abandonment when John's mother gave birth to John's younger brother, and John's first crime -- stealing his mothers priceless broach and getting caught with it. Having discovered this, Adler cured John, and returned their minds to their proper bodies before John turned himself in to pay his debt to society. Adler's subsequent activities are unknown.

fields.notes: While Dr. Adler claims that his abilities are hypnotic in nature, if taken on a literal level they defy the limitations of hypnosis, as it generally does not allow minds to be transplanted from one body to the other. Given that Adler was able to "implant" his mind and those of Captain America and Golden Girl into the mind of John Dolan and the almost literal interpretations of the human mind they encountered there, it seems more likely that Adler was some kind of telepath and that they were all interacting in the astral plane. If true, one could speculate that either Adler was unaware of this ability (hence calling it "hypnosis") or was merely creating a cover story to disguise his true nature.

sigmund fell.name: Sigmund Fell
sigmund fell.origin: An android created at an unknown point, Fell believed himself the creator of the very race of androids he was actually a part of, believed to have been built upon the ideas of his "father", and "grandfather", secretly another android and their ultimate creator, a man whose ideas had been stolen from Phineas Horton. The one flaw with the androids was that, when exposed to air, they would burst into flame. Secreted within a sealed city in Bolivia known as New Berlin, specially treated air prevented the androids from bursting into flame, and the citizens believed themselves to exist within the actual Berlin of a world ruled by the Nazis. Fell, wanting help with his ultimate construction, made an attempt at creating an entity similar to the original Human Torch by abducting the Mad Thinker and brought him to New Berlin. There, he forced the Thinker to finish the construction of the entity, dubbing it the Inhuman Torch. Losing control of his creation, it began burning its way through New Berlin. Realizing his control was gone, Fell made plans to escape and rebuild elsewhere. After a brief altercation with the Mad Thinker, Fell brought him to the surface at gun point, where the Thinker revealed his theory on Fell's true origins as Fell erupted in flame, just like the androids he'd ruled for so long. The Thinker then teleported away, leaving Fell, whose flaming skeleton fell to the jungle floor.

signor korte.name: Signor Korte
signor korte.origin: Signor Korte was a diplomat who was active in Washington D.C. during the 1940s. He was involved in international espionage and attempted to steal government secrets from the United States. The only individuals who were aware of his espionage activities were OSS agent Mark Mason and the costumed adventurer known as the Blonde Phantom. However, without sufficient evidence the pair were never able to arrest Korte due to his diplomatic immunity. He had the loyalty of United States Senator Mushbell who did his bidding. In his earliest recorded act of espionage, circa 1946, Korte secretly hired Walter Edgar a spy with a photographic memory to pose as atomic scientist Homer Johns. Having Johns murdered, Walters then infiltrated an atomic energy meeting among leading scientist and memorized all that was said. However, before he could report back to his employer, he and his men were captured by Mark Mason and Blonde Phantom. Although without knowing the true identity of his employer, Edgar was unable to implicate Korte in the plot. Korte soon began plotting anew, and vowing vengeance against Mason and the Blonde Phantom. Signor Korte's next plot involved stealing the plans for a new radio control atomic bomb being developed by the American military. To this end, he hired international spy and master of disguise False Face to pose as Colonel Ryder. False Face's mission was to steal the plans, then reprogram the prototype to launch at New York City, in the hopes that the United States would abandon further development of the weapon allowing Korte to sell the plans to the highest bidder. Although False Face succeeded in replacing Ryder, Mark Mason became suspicious when Korte came to see the missile for himself. After Korte left, False Face was exposed by the Blonde Phantom, but not before he could launch the missile with Mark trapped inside. Blonde Phantom rescued Mark, who had reprogrammed the missile to it's original target where it exploded harmlessly. When questioning False Face in prison he denied working for anyone but himself. Korte next set up a team of spies to operate the beauty parlour called La Glamour. This was a front in which the spies used hypnotic techniques to gain government secrets from the wives of high ranking government officials. Suspecting that the spies would be caught soon, Korte secretly poisoned the leader. Later, when the Blonde Phantom led the spies into a trap, but when they questioned their leader, he succumbed to the poison. When last seen, Signor Korte was still at large, with Mark Mason and Blonde Phantom no closer to implicating him in any crime. His subsequent fate is unknown.
powers: No known paranormal powers

sigrid.name: Sigrid
sigrid.origin: The events of Sigrid's early life have not been recorded. As an adult, Sigrid had grown tired of waiting to be married off, instead longing to sail alongside the young men of the village in raids and battle. After being ridiculed by Ragnar the Dreamy, one of the men from the voyage crew, Sigrid was left behind in the village, much to her chagrin. While lamenting over her predicament to her unsympathetic father, Sigrid vanished into thin air, transported to the limbo-like dimension where "time flows like a river". Sigrid soon learned that she had been transported to New York City in the year 2003 by Dr. Strange in order to help Thor defeat ancient Viking warrior Harald Jaekelsson. Sigrid further learned that she was was chosen for the task, along with Sir Magnus and Erik Lonnroth, because they were the distant descendants of a Norse wise man from the town of Lakstad, who had haphazardly cursed Jaekelsson and his Viking crew with a rune stone, which had left the Vikings unable to die. According to Strange's reasoning, since the blood of the wise man had powered the rune curse, the descendants of his bloodline should be able to counter the curse's power. While Magnus and Sigrid were on board with the plan, Erik found the entire story doubtful, and questioned if he was dreaming or drunk. After discussing the plan, Sigrid and Magnus convinced Erik that the possibility of magic Vikings was not that far-fetched, reminding the pilot that he traveled the skies in an "eagle of iron". Seeing their points, and the horrors the Vikings were inflicting on the citizens of New York City, Erik agreed to fight. Contributing her blood to a magical brew whipped up by Dr. Strange, Sigrid took the potion, and headed out into the city. While Erik attacked Jaekelsson and his flying longboat near the Woolworth building, Thor, Sigrid and Magnus took on Jaekelsson's Vikings on the ground. After three warriors made easy work of Jaekelsson's Vikings, Magnus and Sigrid questioned Thor as to Jaekelsson's whereabouts. Before they could spot him, Jaekelsson appeared behind Thor, and ran him through with his broadsword. Rushing to Thor's aid, Sigrid was bested by Jaekelsson, taking a blow to the face and falling in to some nearby bushes. Sigrid regained her composure just in time to see Thor launch Jaekelsson's body into orbit. After saying her goodbyes to the rest of her comrades, Sigrid was sent back to her own time by Dr. Strange. The Rivers of Time show that Sigrid eventually died in combat, having been impaled by a multitude of spears. She was also shown to have entered Valhalla, the Norse realm of heroes, upon her death, along with Magnus and Erik.

sigurd earth sprite.name: Sigurd (Earth Sprite)
sigurd earth sprite.origin: Sigurd was the son of the Earth Sprites who resided in a forest he claimed as his own. When Thor, Balder and Loki returned from a mission for Odin and tried to cross the forest on their way home, Sigurd barred their way and challenged them to a duel. Thor accepted, but during the battle, he realized how Sigurd became ever stronger. When Balder informed Thor that Sigurd became stronger every time he touched the ground, Thor flung him into space, where his feet would not touch the ground any more.
powers: Connected to the power of Earth, Sigurd becomes stronger every time he touches the ground.

siingard.name: Siingard
siingard.origin: Siingard was a very powerful Frost Giant. His sister had a child with the monster known as the Fenris Wolf, a giant wolf-like creature they named Hoarfen. Hoarfen's existence was planned to be a secret but word of it leaked out. He was given the task of guarding the castle of Siingard. Many years later the Warriors Three, Hulk and his wife Betty, along with Red Norvell and some of the Pantheon were pursuing Agamemnon to Siingard's castle. The Frost Giant Siingard then unleashed Hoarfen to protect Agamemnon. Siingard's first order to the wolf Hoarfen was to kill "the green one" (Hulk). Hector eventually caught Agamemnon when Hoarfen was released. Hoarfen thundered towards the band of heroes making Hector drop Agamemnon into the Hulk's arms. Hoarfen then grabbed the Hulk and Agamemnon in his mouth, killing the two. Hoarfen then proceeded to attack the others who attacks prove useless against the giant wolf Hoarfen as no weapon could harm him. Hela later brings the Hulk and Agamemnon back to life and appear in Hoarfen's mouth. The Hulk would then proceed in opening Hoarfen's mouth too wide, fracturing his mandibles which lead to Hoarfen fleeing the scene.

sila.name: Sila
sila.origin: Sila was the spiritual embodiment of the soul of Northern Canada residing in the Aurora Borealis. They were pulled from their slumber by the Master of the World and trapped in a containment field inside a facility which the villain planned to use to repair the damage caused by the glaciers by global warming. Young Inuk Amka Aliyak broke into the facility to investigate its nature, and stumbled upon Sila's containment cell. The young girl managed to free Sila, though in the process caused an explosion that fatally injured her. In gratitude, Sila healed her injuries in a flash of light. Having been imparted with Sila's energy, Amka was trapped inside the factory until her rescue by Spider-Man when the Champions investigated the Master of the World's machinations. Having been imbued with powers by Sila, Amka chose to become a superhero and train with the Champions under the alias of Snowguard.

silas ellerby.name: Silas Ellerby
silas ellerby.origin: Silas Ellerby was a poor underclass man born in England in the mid-1800s. At puberty, Silas developed geokinetic mutant powers. Silas tried to hide these powers from everyone except his wife Lucy, but rumors began to spread in London nonetheless. In 1856, Silas and Lucy boarded the Duke of Milan bound for a gold rush in Port Phillip, Australia. Unfortunately, a storm hit destroying the ship and killing everyone onboard except Silas who was stranded on Krakoa. Alone on Krakoa, his powers stopped Krakoa from draining his life force leaving Silas to use his powers to create the palace he had designed for Lucy. Physically hurt by Silas' creation, Krakoa reached out to the wreckage of Duke of Milan to retrieve Lucy's corpse. Possessing Lucy's corpse, Krakoa scared Silas and caused him to fall out of a window and died. Following Silas' death, Krakoa reabsorbed his palace. Krakoa never forgot this event and eventually shared the details with Cypher in the modern era and Cypher shared this story at campfire with younger mutants.

silas fireheart.name: Silas Fireheart
silas fireheart.origin: Silas Fireheart is a Native American of the Eastern Keewazi living together with his cousin, Frank, and their grandmother at the Sweet Medicine Indian Reservation, which had fallen into poverty due to the contamination of their water spring, the reservation's main source of income. The Firehearts welcomed Hawkeye and deputy Red Wolf when the former visited the reservation to see for himself its condition and try to find a way to help its people. When Hawkeye and Red Wolf were captured by an armed militia while investigating the reservation, the Fireheart cousins caught notice of the confrontation, and subsequently followed the militia when they brought the heroes to a secret water pumping station at a previously unknown second water spring located in an alleged hazard zone. The Firehearts charged against the militia and their hired goon Hydro-Man, and helped the heroes defeat them. Silas notably incapacitated Hydro-Man by electrocuting him. Once the authorities arrived, it was determined that the toxic waste leak and the contaminated water at Sweet Medicine's spring were both part of a ruse orchestrated by Oasis Spring Water to draw attention from the second secret underground reservoir from where they were stealing. ===Secret Empire=== After Steve Rogers revealed himself to be a Hydra sleeper agent and overthrew the United States of America to establish a Hydra Empire, Silas joined the Underground.

silas grant.name: Silas Grant
silas grant.origin: Silas Grant was a denizen of Blackworld. Thanks to the manipulations of Ego-Prime, the Blackworld went through an extreme evolution, going from medieval times to the 20th Century in a matter of days. Lady Sif and Hildegarde found Silas in a 19th century era steamboat shortly after their encounter with medieval knights. Silas immediately befriended Sif and Hildegarde. He later assisted Sif's paramour, the Mighty Thor, and was involved with a number of adventures with the Thunder God. Silas Grant also befriended and lived with the Rigellian Tana Nile. Ironically, it was Nile whose machinations inadvertently led to the destruction of Silas Grant's home planet of the Blackworld. Silas Grant said his goodbyes to Thor and his fellow Asgardians after their victory over the Black Stars. He told Thor how close Tana Nile and him had become, and they were going to live together and venture out with the other Rigellians.

silas haggle.name: Silas Haggle
silas haggle.origin: thumb|left|150pxSilas Haggle was a wealthy but corrupt industrialist known for his ruthless business practices and deep resentment toward his rivals. After purchasing an antique mirror with a gold frame from a curiosity shop, Haggle discovered that the object possessed magical properties allowing him to imprison anyone he wished inside it. Enraged upon reading in the newspaper that his rival J.J. Jones had secured a lucrative contract ahead of him, Haggle angrily wished that Jones would disappear from his path forever. Instantly, Jones’ image appeared trapped within the mirror, revealing its supernatural power. Emboldened, Haggle used the mirror repeatedly, banishing numerous rivals and individuals he disliked, including another competitor, Smedley, whose likeness soon appeared beside Jones within the glass. Over time, dozens of victims were imprisoned by Haggle’s careless wishes. His actions came to an end when agents of the IRS arrived intending to audit his finances. Realizing that eliminating them would only bring more investigators, Haggle instead wished that no one would ever bother him again. The wish was granted literally: all previous prisoners were released from the mirror, and Haggle himself became its sole captive, condemned to the same fate he had inflicted upon others.

silas mears.origin: Silas Mears was in love with a woman named Mary, however she was taken away from him. After his death, he left his farm to Mary's daughter Nancy in order to separate her from her husband John. The pair visited the farm and Silas attacked the pair. silas redmond.name: Silas Redmond
silas redmond.origin: Pirate Captain Silas Redmond welcomed aboard his ship Davy Jones, who was sailing alone in search of friendship. Once aboard the ship, however, Davy Jones did not carry out his assigned tasks, and with each attempt to punish him by the Captain, the sky blackened and a storm began. Even worse, not withstanding piracy, the pirates had not been able to capture any ships since Jones had been aboard. At the limit of endurance, Captain Redmond was about to strike Jones with his cutlass when a sudden hurricane hit the ship, causing it to sink. The crew members managed to save themselves on the lifeboats but Captain Redmond and his two mates sank along with the ship, but Davy Jones did not let them die but took them with him to his abode in the deep sea where he would have companions to play cards with.

silas stevens.name: Silas Stevens
silas stevens.origin: thumb|left|107px|Silas Stevens Silas Stevens was a swindler who was active in the 1940s. By 1947, his activities were uncovered by lawyer Roger Hatch and his partner Richard Alton who began blackmailing him to keep quiet. Having gone deaf five years prior, Stevens had learned to read lips. Coincidentally he lived across the street from Roger Hatche's nephew, Hillary King. King was a struggling writer who was embittered by the fact that his uncle had refused to support his struggling craft. King often mumbled his plots as he wrote them, and began writing a story called the "Green Masked Killer" that was inspired by his desire to get revenge against his uncle. Reading King's lips, Stevens then decided to murder Hatch and Alton using the Green Masked Killer identity hoping to frame up Hillary King. Stevens then kidnapped King after his landlady overheard him mumbling a plot point and thinking he truly wanted to kill his uncle. He then went to the home of Roger Hatch and killed him with a poison dart. Tipped off by the land lady, the Human Torch and Toro arrived on the scene too late to stop the killing. Having anticipated their arrival, the Green Masked Killer had set up a tank of water to douse their flames and escaped. Doffing his disguise, Silas got into the crowd of rubberneckers who had come to King's boarding house to gawk at the police and spoke with the authorities in an apparent attempt to avoid suspicion. He then resumed his guise of the Green Masked Killer and eliminated Richard Alton. Realizing that the blackmail letters were still at Roger Hatch's home, the Killer went back and caught the Torch and Toro just as they had found them. He then knocked the heroes out with gas and destroyed the remaining evidence. Silas then returned to his home to eliminate Hillary King, but the Torch and Toro -- having deduced the true identity of the killer -- stormed in and easily subdued Stevens, who confessed his entire crime and was turned over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.
abilities: Silas Stevens is an expert lip reader.
weapons: As the Green Masked Killer, Silas Stevens used a dart gun to fire poisoned darts and had a gas sprayer that could douse the Torch and Toro's flames.
weaknesses: Silas Stevens is completely deaf.

silas thorne.name: Silas Thorne
silas thorne.origin: Silas Thorne was the brother of Las Vegas magnate Cassandra Mercury, as well as the owner of Forbidden City, a casino which competed with Cassandra's much more popular Mercury Rising. In an attempt to discredit Cassandra's casino, Silas had gunmen attack the lobby of Mercury Rising, and then pointed a group of novice vigilantes called the Web Spinners towards Cassandra, causing another scene. Following Hydra's empire during which Las Vegas was almost destroyed, Silas continued antagonizing his sister, despite her having previously found out he was behind the attacks on her casino. Thorne hired the Hornet to target a shipment of food meant for Mercury Rising, which Cassandra had turned into a temporary shelter for the victims of Hydra's destruction, claiming she was hoarding the food and giving it only to her guests. After fighting the Hornet to protect the shipment, the Scarlet Spider confronted Silas. Disgusted by Thorne's willingness to jeopardize innocent people for the sake of his feud against Cassandra, the Scarlet Spider beat him up to a pulp with the warning to leave Mercury alone.

silence demon.name: Silence (Demon)
silence demon.origin: ===Origins and early years=== The Silence is a creature whose origin is unknown. Long ago, it fought the sorcerer Raama. Raama won but couldn't fully destroy it. He consequently sealed the Silence away in a crypt called the Skull of Silence, locked behind the Seal of Raama. Because the sea was the Silence's weakness, Raama imbued a gong that when struck gave off the sound of the sea that was to be used to keep the creature at bay. ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age of Kull=== Long after Raama's passing, King Kull foolishly released the Silence from its prison despite warnings not to do so. The Silence nearly killed Kull, but Kull was able to subdue it by striking the gong, though he hit it with too much force and destroyed it. Kull quickly sealed the Silence away and declared that no one should ever open the doors again.
powers: The Silence has the power to rob an area entirely of its sound, driving living things in the area mad.

silent claw.name: Silent Claw
silent claw.origin: The man who became known as Silent Claw was a circus performer who operated under the stage named of Jason the Great and worked with a female partner. At some point in 1956, Jason went insane due to unknown circumstances. Finding a resemblance to his former circus partner and the African adventurer known as Lorna the Jungle Girl, Jason travelled to the jungles of Africa to kill her and all the animals he found there. To this end, he developed a glove fashioned after the claw of a feline predator and coated the claws with a lethal poison and began attacking anything that he crossed paths with. To the local natives and white hunter Greg Knight, the stalker became known as the Silent Claw. Learning of the "creature's" existence, Lorna went out looking for the Silent Claw herself, encountering him as he was attempting to attack a leopard. Lorna then gathered some animals and sent Jason fleeing into the jungles. Silent Claw plotted revenge but ultimately fell asleep in the jungles, leaving himself open for attack. Finding him, Lorna quickly removed the slumbering maniac's weapon and easily defeated him in combat. She then turned him over to a doctor who explained Jason's origins to her and Greg Knight, and he was effectively cured of his insanity. Jason's subsequent fate is unknown.
weapons: As the Silent Claw, Jason wore a gauntlet fashioned after the paw of a panther. The claws on the glove were laced with a lethal poison that proved to be fatal upon introduction into the bloodstream of a living creature.

silent fox.name: Silent Fox
silent fox.origin: Silent Fox was the leader of the Keewazi people, a Native American tribe that lived on a reservation in Oklahoma. He was the father of William Wingfoot, and grandfather of Wyatt Wingfoot, a long time associate of the super-heroes known as the Fantastic Four. Before Wyatt was born, Silent Fox, a sorcerer in his own right, was able to stop an attack by a monster calling itself Orrgo because he knew that "Orrgo" was actually the demon KhLΘg in a borrowed form. Decades later, Silent Fox and his people were terrorized by what they thought was the Manidoog deity known as Tomazooma. Wyatt brought the Fantastic Four to investigate and they discovered that "Tomazooma" was actually a robot constructed by the Red Star Oil Company who were trying to frighten the Keewazi off their land so they could get to the oil buried there. Some time later, Silent Fox and his people were terrorized by the Miracle Man, who had stolen the reality altering powers of the long lost Cheemuzwa Tribe. Once again Wyatt and the Fantastic Four came to the aid of the Keewazi people and defeated the Miracle Man, who was later taken into the custody of the Cheemuzwa. Silent Fox later was present when Wyatt was possessed by the demon Dryminextes, until he was exorcised by the Human Torch and Son of Satan. In more recent times, Silent Fox died -- probably of old age -- and the mantle of leadership of the Keewazi was passed on to his grandson Wyatt. Some time later, Wyatt, Sorcerer Supreme Doctor Strange and the Fantastic Four's Human Torch and Thing attempted to summon his spirit from the afterlife in order to learn how they could defeat the being who had once posed as Orrgo. However, the Silent Fox who appeared and told them the story of KhLΘg was actually the demon itself in the borrowed shape of Silent Fox.

silk stocking strangler.name: Silk Stocking Strangler
silk stocking strangler.origin: Not much is known about the past history of the man known as the Silk Stocking Strangler, who terrorized the San Francisco area in 1946. His first name was Frank and he was a writer who took pride in his sophisticated lyrical composition. He was dating a young woman who was a cabaret singer. When she developed the song "Let Me Be Your Sweetheart" her popularity soared, much to the chagrin of Frank who hated it for its simplicity. One night after a performance, Frank snapped during an argument and strangled his girl to death with her own silk stockings. Having gone completely insane from the experience, Frank went on a nightly murder spree, strangling women along San Francisco's waterfront, especially those who might be caught singing "Let Me Be Your Sweetheart". After months of killing, Frank was dubbed the "Silk Stocking Strangler" by the media and frustrated police who could not capture him. After a few months of terror, the authorities called in Captain America and Bucky to help with the investigation. They first encountered the Strangler one foggy night on the Golden Gate Bridge while he was attacking a couple. The two heroes failed to stop the Strangler from killing the girl and escaping in the thick fog. Soon a police drag net was expanded along the waterfront which was briefly frustrated by a group of crooks who used the Strangler hysteria to throw off police investigations into their crimes, however they were quickly apprehended when Captain America deduced that they were impostors. By this time, the police have rounded up three men along the waterfront, of them the actual Strangler. Seeking to flush the killer out, Captain America had the suspects all interviewed by the chief of police, with a pair of stockings on his desk to try and unnerve them. When Frank did not vocally react to the stockings, Captain America noted that he could not keep his eyes off them and was also whistling "Let Me Be Your Sweetheart". Correctly deducing that Frank was the Strangler, Cap and Bucky followed him back to his apartment. There, they got the aid of his neighbour to lure him out to attack by singing "Let Me Be Your Sweetheart". When the Strangler attack, Captain America and Bucky stopped him from killing the girl and chased him up onto the roof of the building. As the Strangler attempted to flee the scene he stumbled off the roof and suffered a fatal fall.
weapons: The Strangler used a pair of women's silk stockings to strangle his victims.

silky kirby.name: Silky Kirby
silky kirby.origin: Silky Kirby was a racketeer who used his criminal reputation to try and influence the results of horse races. With his agent Spike, he threatened jockeys to throw races so that bets would win in his favor and he could get the biggest pay out at the tracks. When jockey Earl Sikes refused to throw the race, he was shot by Spike and left to die. Unfortunately for Kirby, the Whizzer was on sight and raced Sikes to a hospital. Learning of Silky Kirby's operation, the speedster tracked Kirby to his hideout. There, the hero made short work of Kirby's men and in the heat of the battle, Kirby suffered a heart attack and died. With their leader dead, Kirby's gang was easily rounded up and turned over to the police.
weaknesses: Silky Kirby had a weak heart.

silo.name: Silo
silo.origin: In the late 37th-early 39th century, Silo was a member of the Clan Chosen. Roughly in the late 36th century, Apocalypse ascended to power and ruled much of North America unchallenged, for 100 years, where humans and whoever else resistant to his rule could be killed at any moment. The Clan Askani were the only rebellion left to opposed Apocalypse's rule. Years later, following the destruction of the Askani Sisterhood, by the New Canaanites led by Ch'vayre and Stryfe, and Apocalypse, by Nathan Dayspring, Silo joined the Clan Chosen, an Askani-inspired team of freedom fighters, formed originally by Nathan, Tetherblood, and Aliya. Training in the Askani ways under surviving Askani elders, the Clan Chosen repeatedly battled the New Canaanites and the Scions of Apocalypse, led by Stryfe. The Clan Chosen also clashed with the Neo-Canaanites, a group that also wished to claim Apocalypse's power. After decades of battle, the Clan Chosen signed a long-lasting peace treaty with the New Canaanites, but Nathan, upset by rumors that Apocalypse had survived, convinced the Clan's Askani Council that they needed to fight again. Silo battled the Flatliners and destroyed the Tinex in Niagara Falls, after sending Cable and Kane to the past.

silver ghost.name: Silver Ghost
silver ghost.first_appearance: Captain America and the Mighty Avengers Vol 1 2
silver ghost.origin: Silver Ghost was one of the members of Blue Streak's newest team, the Fast Five. Soon after robbing a bank, the team skated through the city, but soon came across Spectrum of the Mighty Avengers, they divided to avoid capture, but the other Avengers followed their trail. Silver Ghost used her suit's shielding to deflect Spectrum's attack, and then turned on an anti-visibility coating to continue her escape. However, Spectrum followed her radiation trail, and altered her light-form to impersonate Blue Streak to get close enough to Silver Ghost to take her by surprise and phase through her suit, knocking her out. Silver Ghost and the rest of the Fast Five were seen as inmates at Pleasant Hill. After her confinement, Silver Ghost later appeared in New York City with her team as they ransacked a Damage Control convoy filled with Asgardian weapons left behind from the War of the Realms. As she tried to make a get away, the team and her were confronted by the new Valkyrie. Silver Ghost activated her invisibility coating in hopes that Valkyrie wouldn't be able to follow, but somehow Foster used some kind of enhanced vision which allowed her to see Silver Ghost fleeing the scene. She used her All-Weapon Undrjarn as a bolo and fired it at Silver Ghost tangling around her feet causing her to fall over. Silver Ghost was then apprehended and taken into custody by the NYPD along with her teammates.
powers: Silver Ghost doesn't possess any powers on her own. She uses her armor's technology to make her invisible.
abilities: She is an expert skater.

silver sky.name: Silver Sky
silver sky.origin: Silver Sky was a Native American, tribal elder of the Kisani People, living in Lost Mesa Reservation. When shaman Joseph Threetrees invited the Hulk for a ceremony, fellow elder Crazy Fox disapproved because the elders had reserved the right to decide that; Silver Sky, unlike Crazy Fox, did not believe that was their privilege. Silver Sky shared food with the Hulk and asked whether the Hulk was religious; the Hulk, misunderstanding, told Silver Sky that he had battered god Thor, which Silver Sky found hilarious; Silver Sky told the Hulk that the shaman and his family were not funny people.

silver surfer grifter.name: Silver Surfer (Grifter)
silver surfer grifter.origin: This unnamed alien grifter travelled the cosmos impersonating the Silver Surfer. Accompanied by his entourage, this "Silver Surfer" visited different worlds claiming to be heralding Galactus' arrival. He then demanded that their inhabitants handed them over all of their riches, pretending that he would convince Galactus not to devour their planet if they complied. The last planet targeted by these scammers was Chitt-crrt. When they returned to the planet three days after presenting their demands, they were confronted by Squirrel Girl. She had travelled to Chitt-crrt to rescue her friends Nancy Whitehead and Tippy-Toe, since they had been abducted by the inhabitants of Chitt-crrt, the Chrrt-chuk, because they believed Tippy-Toe to be capable of finding a way to fend off Galactus. Soon after Squirrel Girl arrived, the Chrrt-chuk deduced the truth behind their visit from the "Silver Surfer." thumb|left|Impersonating the Silver Surfer In an attempt to give the space grifters a taste of their own medicine, Nancy had came up with the idea to use Chitt-crrt's advanced holographic technology to cast an image of Galactus and use it to scare the scammers when they returned. Unfortunately, the holographic emmiters couldn't keep the holographic Galactus running, so the plan fell apart rather quickly. While Squirrel Girl was trying to have the grifters admit their scam, the real Silver Surfer arrived. Mistakenly believing him to be part of the grifter entourage, she attacked him. While the Silver Surfer and Squirrel Girl were clearing up the misunderstanding, the scammers attempted to fly away. They were teleported back to Chitt-crrt by the Silver Surfer, and attempted to talk their way out of punishment. The Silver Surfer was then attacked by a fleet of ships representing every planet scammed by the grifters. While he and Squirrel Girl reasoned with their representatives, the grifters were left under the watch of Squirrel Girl's allies Loki and Drax the Destroyer. After obtaining a portion of the Power Cosmic, Nancy confronted the grifters and tried to punish. Squirrel Girl convinced her not to resort to violence. The scammers tried to run away after Nancy calmed down, but they were subdued by the Silver Surfer. In the end, the grifters were forced to carry out manual labor on the planets they scammed to repay for the money they stole.

silvester meek.name: Silvester Meek
silvester meek.origin: Silvester Meek was the owner of a small antiquarian bookstore who was struggling financially, to the point that he repeatedly postponed his marriage to his fiancée, Daisy Printwhistle. One day a man offered to sell him two old books, which Meek purchased for only a few dollars. In one of them he discovered the legend of King Midas along with instructions for preparing a potion that supposedly granted the "Midas Touch." Before attempting the experiment, Silvester and Daisy visited their friend, scientist Ralph Avery. After examining the formula, Avery dismissed it as nonsense and advised Silvester to ignore such alchemy and superstition. Refusing to believe him, Silvester gathered the ingredients and prepared the potion himself. During the process, a strange mist filled the room, which Silvester assumed had drifted in from outside. After drinking the potion, Silvester discovered that the Midas Touch was real: everything he touched turned into gold. However, the power proved impossible to control. He could not even touch food, and anything that came into contact with him—including his clothing—was transformed into gold. Furthermore, objects that had been turned into gold spread the effect to whatever they touched, like a contagion. The police attempted to stop him to prevent further transformations, but they failed. One officer, Harry, was turned into gold when Silvester touched him. Even bullets fired at him became gold upon contact, and tear gas transformed into golden dust. Desperate, Daisy turned to Ralph Avery for help. Believing Daisy had abandoned him for Avery, Silvester angrily followed her there, but learned she was seeking a solution to his condition. Avery carefully questioned him about the potion's preparation and became intrigued when Silvester mentioned the strange mist in the room, despite the fact that there had been no fog that day. Investigating the room, Avery collected a lingering trace of the mist and analyzed it, discovering it was of alien origin and responsible for the Midas-like effect. Following its trail, he located an alien spacecraft responsible for the phenomenon. Threatening to alert authorities who would destroy them if they did not leave, Avery forced the aliens to abandon their attempted invasion. With the alien influence gone, Silvester returned to normal. The experience convinced him that wealth was unnecessary to secure Daisy's love, and that their relationship did not depend on riches.

silvia lopez.name: Silvia Lopez
silvia lopez.origin: Silvia Lopez was a scientist who was "owned" by the Kingpin. She was introduced to Dr. Johnathon Ohnn as his new lab assistant for his inter-dimensional project. Their experiments were a success, but Johnathon was accidentally sucked into a portal, and became a magnet to the portals which attached to him. Calling himself the Spot, he planned to set up his own lab for him and Silvia, with whom he had fallen in love. He also planned to take down the Kingpin, but Fisk had already taken Silvia hostage. Ohnn then teamed up with Spider-Man to save her, but everyone became distracted by the portal which had previously been left open by Ohnn, which had widened and threatened to engulf the entire world. Kingpin put aside his differences and provided Ohnn with a plane so that he could close it, and Johnathon sacrificed himself to do so, along with Silvia who went with him so that they could be together.
