skin bender.name: Skin-Bender
skin bender.origin: The Skin-Bender is a demon who has the ability mold the flesh of other beings into whatever she wants. She started to terrorized a small town that Johnny Blaze was in. She found out that she can't affect the flesh of Blaze, as he was already changed. She demanded to know who changed him and threatened to hurt a child if he didn't tell her. Johnny gave her the answer and she wanted to see his "true face". To feel the fire that burned inside of him. When Johnny turned into the Ghost Rider she was fascinated, seeing him as the most beautiful thing she had ever seen, strangely falling in love with him. She offered herself to him and to work together to change the world in a twisted way, all he had to do was to say the word. However, the only word the Ghost Rider said to her was "Burn" as the sky rained fire that destroyed her followers and restored most of the other people to normal. Despite this the Skin-Bender was happy as she believed that he was embracing her with his fire as she burned. Johnny turned her into a ball of burned flesh and bone with one eye, while she still asking him to burn her again, and throw her far away into the sea. Later, a sailor from the same town people told the story to his mates while fishing, which they didn't believe, and while they were pulling the net they were attacked by twisted sea creatures and the one who told the story of the flesh demon was confronted by the same demon he told its tale moments ago asking him to give her a hug.
powers: Skin-Bender has the power to twist the flesh of any living being.
weaknesses: She is vulnerable to the fire of the Ghost Rider. Though she won't die, she will be weakened by it.

skinner lilin.name: Skinner (Lilin)
skinner lilin.first_appearance: Ghost Rider/Blaze: Spirits of Vengeance Vol 1 3
skinner lilin.origin: Skinner was said to be the most brutal Lilin to ever walk the Earth. After the fall of Lilith, Skinner went into hiding. Years later after Lilith came back, she went seeking for the other Lilin. This lead her to search for Skinner. When she found him, she found he had started a family with mortals in the woods. At first Blackout and Pilgrim tried to talk to Skinner but failed. However, he was then persuaded by Lilith. In the end Skinner killed his human family and joined the Lilin once again. This led him into confrontation with Johnny Blaze. After a violent struggle, Skinner was seemingly burned to death by Blaze until his skeleton emerged from the flames. Skinner lamented how Blaze destroyed the only thing he had left of his human family; their skin which he wore. Ghost Rider arrived in time to aid Blaze who shot hellfire from his shotgun into Skinner over and over again. As they left, Skinner rose from the flames again. Months later after Lilith's second return, Skinner got himself back to health and went after Blaze again this time seriously wounding him almost killing him. He would later appear in the Black Hole where he was stopped by Ghost Rider.
weapons: Skinner possesses razor-sharp protrusions of bone from all over his body, enabling him to cut through wood, concrete, and even steel.

skol.name: Skol
skol.origin: Travelling to England to search for their missing comrade, the Black Knight, the Avengers arrived at the Garrett Castle where they find that it's protected by an invisible barrier. Their presence near the castle alerts the attention of Skol and his army of Troglodytes, a group of underground dwellers who were forced into living under the castle for centuries. They capture the Avengers and take them prisoner, where they are blamed for the barrier blocking their path as the Troglodytes used an underground entrance into the castle to steal food. After battling a giant insect, and fighting off the attacking Troglodytes, Skol surrenders to the Avengers. The Avengers, however, decide to help the Troglodytes out by making arrangements with the British government to aid these underground dwellers.

skol abdhur.name: Skol Abdhur
skol abdhur.origin: Skol Abdhur, also called "the Butcher", was the lord and master of Bab-El-Shaithan, who managed to keep the men in check with a ruby, the Blood of Bel-Hissar (named after the Acheronian monarch Bel-Hissar), which he took from the body of a slain Himelian chieftain. Should another man slay him and take it, that man would become a target, so the outlaws were content to let Abdhur play them against each other. He learned of the jewel's secrets and of its blood-craving, which he sated with the blood of women who came in Bab-El-Shaithan. The night after the arrival of Conan, Suwaan, and Turghol, Suwaan hired out two brigands to slay Skol Abdhur along with his Kushite bodyguards, and help her steal his ruby. The Cimmerian was fingered guilty by Suwaan, who lied about having seen him take the jewel from Skol Abdhur's body. It was in fact Turghol who managed to snatch the Blood, taking it from the body of one of Suwaan's brigands that he slew.

skratt.name: Skratt
skratt.origin: Skrat was a Snark scout tasked with finding Power Pack for Queen Maraud. He managed to find Power Pack's house when Katie, in a moment of anger, used her powers, allowing Skrat to track her energy signature. His father ordered him to wait for back-up and not engage Power Pack alone in combat, but Skrat convinced him to give him this chance to proof himself, hoping to get promotion to warrior class Snark if he succeeded. He went to the house, but Power Pack easily defeated him and forced him to retreat. Sometime later, Skrat decided to team up with Jeremy, a human crook who had just been defeated by Power Pack. Skrat gave Jeremy superpowers of his own so he could be a match for Power Pack. Since Julie had decided to quit Power Pack at the time, Skrat and Jeremy were able to defeat the other 3 members of Power Pack and capture them. The two brought the captured kids to their house in an attempt to lure Julie out of hiding. Julie however managed to free her siblings, after which the four of them lured Skrat and Jeremy into the basement and opened Dr. Power's interdimensional portal. An octopus monster came through the portal and snatched both villains, dragging them into the portal. Neither have been seen since.

skrilkrak.name: Skrilkrak
skrilkrak.origin: The Skrilkrak was a monster who plagued the outer colonies of Vodan and lurked in the Canyons of Sorrow. When the Atlantean king Namor travelled to Vodan to offer King Okun to fold the Voldani back into Atlantis, Okun pretended to consider Namor's offer, and tasked him with the challenge of defeating the Skrilkrak. Okun's daughter Kataw assisted him since she despited her father's archaic beliefs and saw benefit in an alliance with Atlantis. When they ventured into the Canyons of Sorrow, the Skrilkrak attacked Namor and Kataw. The creature was impervious to their initial attacks, and was even strengthened by Kataw's electric discharges. When Namor noticed this, he ordered Kataw to use her powers to absorb the Skrilkrak's electricity, weakening the creature enough for Namor to deliver the final blow and kill it.

skrull x.name: Skrull-X
skrull x.origin: Skrull-X was a Skrull-shaped robot created to be the Super-Skrull's superior and successor. Meant to look like a Scout Warrior, he was tasked of scouting out the planet Xandar. He chased after Queen Adora, the planet's ruler, through a transporter that took them both to Earth. Skrull-X encountered the Fantastic Four and was deactivated with a stasis-ray. Skrull-X eventually reactivated and disguised himself as a machine in the Baxter Building. After learning that the Fantastic Four minus the Human Torch were rapidly aging to death from exposure to a Skrull metabolic ray, he gloated that Earth would be defenseless and be conquered by the Skrull Empire. As Mister Fantastic, Invisible Girl, and Thing were near death by their rapid aging, Skrull-X attacked the now alone Human Torch. Skrull-X held his own against Torch until Torch's anger was pushed to its limit, and he unleashed his full power, melting the robot in a wall of flame.

skull jacket.name: Skull-Jacket
skull jacket.origin: Skull Jacket was an unidentified man who worked for the Russian mafia. He obtained technology which allowed him to duplicate the appearance of a person and obtain their memories if he obtained the person's RNA. He was tasked by Valeri Kasatanov to take the place of Jason Havershaw in order to obtain the money Jason owed him from Jason's mother, Andrea. Kasatanov had Skull Jacket kill Andrea. To this end Skull Jacket obtained the RNA of Black Cat and disguised himself as her and broke into Andrea's apartment and killed her and made it seem as if the crime was committed by Black Cat. To help SkullJacket impersonated Ken Ellis and met with detective Marcella Cellanos who gave him photos of Havershaw's security system showing Black Cat committed the murder to have the Bugle run a story as her being the prime suspect. He later took on the disguise of Jason and attended Haversham's funeral, where he bumped into Ben Reilly, who sensed something was wrong with Jason. Later that evening, back at Haversham's apartment, Skull Jacket still disguised as Jason, was visited by Ben Reilly who used the opportunity to figure out something was wrong with Jason. Skull Jacket then acquired drugs for the real Jason, secretly pursued by Spider-Man.The next day, the police tracked down Jason, suspecting him of murder and Skull Jacket reavealed himself and wounded the officers but Spider-Man was able to take out Skull-Jacket.

skyler wolf.name: Skyler Wolf
skyler wolf.origin: Test pilot Skyler Wolf was brought to a meeting with Matt Slade Jr. on the submarine Lobo II along with Jesse Johns and Sidney Levine. Slade asked the trio to go into occupied Poland in order to rescue his son, Matt Slade III, who had been test piloting a new experimental aircraft. After three days of training with the new experimental aircraft the trio set off for Poland to rescue Slade. The men learned that Slade was being held in a secret Nazi base called Murder Mountain, here they defeated the Steel Kommando and freed Slade from his cell, fighting their way out of the mountain. When they returned to the Lobo II, Sky-Wolf exposed Gretchyn Skul to be a Nazi spy, her father being General Skul. Skyler and the rest of the Sky-Wolves returned to Murder Mountain and subsequently destroyed it. After the mission was complete, Skyler and the rest of the Sky-Wolves decided to remain together as a team in order to fight the Nazis. His post-war activities have yet to be revealed.

slapdash.name: Slapdash
slapdash.species: Spyrican mutated via exposure to cosmic rays
slapdash.origin: Slapdash was the right hand of Big King Scrum, the leader of the Monster Mob, which was the organized horde of rejects from Spyrican society after subjecting themselves to cosmic rays and emerging disfigured. When the Fantastic Four traveled to Spyre and The Thing ended up in Lowtown, he was confronted by the Monster Mob. Slapdash commented the fight to Big King Scrum, who then confronted The Thing personally. After Scrum's defeat, Slapdash announced that The Thing had to kill him to claim the crown of Freak Alley. The Thing refused, and instead rallied the Monster Mob into climbing their way back to Hightown to reclaim their place in society. After the Fantastic Four made peace with Spyre's patriarch, the Overseer, Mister Fantastic shared with the Spyricans a temporary cure that would allow each mutate to regain their normal form once a year. Slapdash was one of the mutates that subjected themselves to the curative procedure.

slate nazi.name: Slate (Nazi)
slate nazi.origin: The man known as Slate was a Nazi spy who was active during World War II. In December of 1943 he joined the crew of an American freight ship for the purposes of marking it with luminescent paint so that it could be easily seen by a wolf pack of Nazi U-boats. As Slate was carrying out his task he was discovered by some of his fellow sailors and murdered them. Unfortunately for Slate, the Angel was aboard the ship returning home to the United States after a visit in England. The hero became suspicious of Slate after finding similar knives as those used by the killer in his bunk. Going to confront Slate he caught the spy red-handed smashing bottles of luminescent paint along the side of the ship. After a brief struggle, the Angel knocked out Slate, learned of the plot and gave the information to the captain. With the location of the Nazi fleet identified, the convoy of the freighter was able to destroy them before they could cause a threat. Slate's subsequent fate is unknown.

slave of souls.name: Slave of Souls
slave of souls.origin: Little is known about the early life of the man only known as the Slave of Souls, before the third wife of one of the less noteworthy Egyptian Pharaohs took a liking to his physical form. She offered to release him from his enslavement in return for serving her for a time. He refused, an act that was worthy of a death sentence in the Queen's eyes. In an extra twist of cruelty, she also coerced one of the court magicians to cast a spell upon the slave's soul, so that it would never die, but instead pass into the bodies of animals and monsters. Thousands of years later, the slave's spirit resided within the soul of Ben Grimm. The slave was semi-aware of his surroundings, but had little-to-no influence on the Thing's life. One day, however, while Ben was visiting his girlfriend Alicia in the hospital, the same wizard caught up to Ben and released a potion that gave the slave control of the body of the Thing. He then proceeded to go on a rampage through New York City, until Alicia caught back up to him and convinced him to return Ben's body, after which he banished himself and the wizard to Limbo.

fields.personality: The slave had a strong sense of right and wrong, to the point where he was not afraid to tell his Queen that she was in the wrong. While possessing the Thing, he showed a deep seated anger, as he tore the city apart in a misguided attempt for justice for the crimes committed long before.

slaymaker.name: Slaymaker
slaymaker.origin: As a young man, the Slaymaster wanted to be an artist but lacked the skill. This pushed him to explore other means of "creating," ultimately leading him to explore the dark arts. He gained the ancient magical power of transfiguration, able to make living tissue obey his commands. Doctor Druid summoned Spider-Woman to help him investigate Slaymaker's actions when he began collecting bodies to make a "Panentropic Engine." The Engine would allow him to re-shape all of reality to his desire. The two were captured and joined the other bodies in the Engine. Cadaver and US Agent, who were seeking Doctor Druid and Spider-Woman respectively, intervened and the distraction allowed Doctor Druid to devise a scheme to destroy the Engine.
powers: Had a variety of magical abilities related to transfiguration, including the ability to control his creations.

slech.name: Slech
slech.origin: Mr. Slech was an Entemen who was born in the 30th or 31st century. At some point in his life, Slech was sent to the world commonly known as Asylum, a planet-wide mental institution for the most hopelessly neurotic patients from some fifty loosely-confederated planets in its sector of the galaxy. Being a very progressive institution, the caretakers allowed the patients to structure their own society which turned out to be uncannily similar to Old Earth, specifically the United States in the 20th century. In this setting, Mr. Slech became the leader of a gang that behaved like mobsters from 1930s America. In 3016 A.D., four members of the Guardians of the Galaxy appeared in his building's roof garden and were captured by an armed gardener, Sod, who brought them to his boss. Slech believed them to be hit men and wanted to know who had sent them but Vance Astro assured him that they meant him no harm and asked to leave. Slech might have agreed to let them go but he made the mistake of caressing Nikki's face with one of his tentacles, angering Charlie-27 who grabbed the tentacle and made a more forceful request that they be allowed to leave. A fight broke out and Slech was taken as a hostage by the Guardians to ensure that they could get away from his floor. The Guardians released Slech before they reached the street.

sleeper beneath the sands.name: Sleeper Beneath the Sands
sleeper beneath the sands.origin: ===Origin=== This creature was one of the "elder spirits", invisible, shapeless shapes, that crossed the dark voids of space to come to Earth in its prime. ===Elder Days and Pre-Cataclysmic Age === As Men rose to supremacy in Lemuria, then on Thuria, these beings fled from sight, awaiting to rise and rule again Earth. While other lied dormant in the ocean or beneath hills, the Sleeper went under the desert, where a temple was erected and a flame kept always burning there. Pilgrims came to him to perform ritual prayers, reading the Words of Power, chanted at long-appointed time. ===Hyborian Age=== During the Hyborian Age of Conan, that task was performed by the caravan led by Ahmed Mullah, which included his daughter Dhira.
powers: The Sleeper and his kind were said to be invisible.

fields.notes: The Sleeper Beneath the Sands was created by Roy Thomas in the eponymous tale ( ), an original story meant as a sequel to A Witch Shall Be Born ( ): At that time, Roy Thomas couldn't use the sequel The Flame Knife by Robert E. Howard and L. Sprague de Camp, as Marvel Comics had obtained the rights only to REH material. He consequently created his own sequel. The origin and tales about the Sleeper and his brethren, only named "Elder Spirits", ancient beings from outer space having ruled upon Earth and awaiting hidden, sleeping and dreaming, to resume their rule of the planet mirrors those of creatures of the Cthulhu Mythos such as the Elder Things or the Old Ones. They also match the Lloigor of "The Return of the Lloigor" (1969) by Colin Wilson, as invisible creatures making themselves manifest as great reptilian beasts, akin to the legendary dragons. They came to the continent of Mu and used humans as slaves. When their power dwindled, the Lloigor retreated below ground and left their former slaves to their own devices. The Appendix to the Handbook of the Marvel Universe consider the Sleeper Beneath the Sands as possibly one of the Old Ones.

sleepy eyes.name: Sleepy Eyes
sleepy eyes.origin: Sleepy Eyes was propositioned by the Yellow Claw in one of his many attempts at world domination. He planned to take over Central City's channel 14 and use Sleepy Eyes' powers of suggestion to put the city to sleep while he robbed them of all their valuables. Unknown to the Yellow Claw, Sleepy Eyes did not like the proposition and decided to go to the F.B.I. and Jimmy Woo to warn them of the Claw's plot. Then instead of mesmerizing the people of the city, Sleepy Eyes used his powers to instead hypnotize the Claw himself into believing that he had put the entire city to sleep. The Claw imagined that his henchmen had robbed the entire city blind and left in his jet plane, only to discover later that his plane was empty.

slick warner.name: Slick Warner
slick warner.origin: Slick Warner was a con-man who worked in the Indianapolis racing business during the 1940s. In the summer of 1943, he was hired for a million dollars to insure that Larry Reynold's new race car the Silver Moonbeam did not win the Indie 500 in order for the mobster to rake in a huge payout. In this capacity, he posed as mechanic Pete Durkle in order to sabotage the racer so that it would crash during the big race. The only oversight on his job was that Larry was good friends with the super-hero known as the Whizzer and had called the hero to see his newest racer and witness the race. Seeing the Whizzer as a potential problem, Slick had a bunch of thugs knock out the hero and take him prisoner just as he realized who "Pete Durkle" really was. This, however, did not stop the Whizzer who promptly broke free from his bonds, rounded up Slick and his men, and turned them over to the authorities. He then raced to the Indie 500 and helped prevent the Sliver Moonbeam from breaking up and crashing, enabling Larry to win first place in the race. Slick's subsequent fate is unknown.

sligguth.name: Sligguth
sligguth.origin: ===Origin and Early Years=== Sligguth was a powerful demon from the dawn of Earth's history. Spawns such as he and his brother, Damballah, were created by the Elder God Set for him to dominate the planet. After Set committed the first murder by killing another Elder God and absorbing his life-force, the Elder Gods degenerated into demons, Gaea mated with the Demiurge to create Atum, a.k.a. Demogorge the God-Eater, who annihilated most of the degenerated Elder Gods. After Set rallied Chthon to try and stop Demogorge, in vain, he created two illusion forms of himself, Sligguth and Damballah, and they fled from the Demogorge's wrath, entering a pocket dimension adjacent to Earth's dimensional space. About 1 million years ago, Sligguth spawned the Dragon Kings and the similar-looking Serpent-Men. ===The Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== Sligguth was a god of the Serpent-Men in Valusia during the Pre-Cataclysmic Age. ===The Modern Age=== Sligguth was active in the town of Starkesboro, New England. He appeared to answer to his High Priestess, Ebora, who worked under the instructions of Shuma-Gorath and led the people of Starkesboro, the Serpent-Men. When Doctor Strange was captured in the church at Starkesboro, Sligguth was about to kill him when Strange was able to break free from his bonds. Sligguth released a fungus which weakened Strange but the sorcerer retaliated with a desperate spell that drove the demon back into its labyrinth to regain its strength. Strange followed the demon down to its lair and called upon the Vishanti, who appeared before him for the first time. They offered very little aid to the sorcerer. Still, Strange was able to harm the demon enough to cause it to retreat into the open waters. Strange, after fending off the High Priestess, fled the water-filled cavern through the same opening and came face-to-face with Sligguth again. After reaching the surface for a gasp of air, Strange was pulled down by the demon, who began to beat him senseless; however, the unholy symbol of Sligguth happened to be floating by and Strange was able to strike the demon with the wooden symbol, knocking the demon unconscious. Strange then squeezed the gills of Sligguth, killing the demon.

affiliations: Shuma-Gorath and religious community leader of the people of Starkesboro

slim smith.name: Slim Smith
slim smith.origin: Slim Smith was active during the days of the American Frontier. He was the long time boyfriend of Arizona Annie and a constant partner in her many early adventures during the days of the American Frontier. He was often completely dumbfounded by her bravery and desire to put herself in danger. He often matched wits with her views on gender roles in their time, and was never beyond playing tricks on Annie for his own amusement. In his first recorded adventure with Annie, he was shocked when Annie joined up with a gang who just robbed woman hating blacksmith Pete Grimm, but was relieved when Annie returned with the stolen loot . Slim ignored Annie's suspicions that local land developer Josiah Cleek was a fraud, but was relieved when Annie proved herself right as he had foolishly invested in one of his lemon properties in Starling Wells . Slim engaged Annie on a conversation where Annie asserted that women were too civil to break laws and that if they ran things the west would be tame. Ironically, Annie was later arrested and accused of being the leader of a gang of bank robbers led supposedly by a woman. However, Annie broke free from jail and captured the gang and their leader an effeminate man named Pretty Face Grimes who disguised himself as a woman to throw off the authorities . Slim and his pals get a good laugh when Annie was convinced to take up a job as school marm at the local school, but Annie still manages to capture a pair of bank robbers despite this . Slim and his friends next played a prank on Annie by convincing local outlaw Grizzly Williams that Annie was secretly in love with him. After Annie sent Williams running she discovered who was responsible for the prank and Slim and his pals ran for cover in a nearby pig pen . Slim Smith later goaded Annie into getting involved in local politics, playing on her opinions on women being the superior sex. This played into Slim's hand and Annie entered the political race and won by a landslide, not informing her that she was fighting to get the position of dog catcher. In retaliation for this, Annie caught Slim and the mayor and paraded them around town in her dog catching wagon . In his last recorded appearance, Slim goaded Annie to participate in a carnival shooting gallery which she soon discovered was fixed and smashed up . Slim Smith has not been seen since, and has apparently parted company with Arizona Annie. The reasons for their separation remain unrevealed.
weapons: Slim carried a single six-shooter pistol that was common for the time period in which he lived.

weapons: Slim carried a single six-shooter pistol that was common for the time period in which he lived.

slim taylor.name: Slim Taylor
slim taylor.origin: Jody was the fourteen-year-old son of Slim Taylor, the "Flying-R" Ranch foreman. After several assaults by a big puma to some cattle, Slim decided to create a posse formed by the other workers of the ranch to hunt the puma and when Jody asked his father if he could go with him, Slim told him that kind of hunting was too dangerous for him and promised him that once he killed the puma he would take him to the spot. Disappointed and resigned, Jody and his dog went hunting rabbits but unfortunately met the big puma themselves and although initially scared, as soon as the dog jumped towards the puma to defend his master Jody recovered and promptly aimed his rifle and he behaved as his father had taught him and managed to kill the puma. Soon after came the father with the posse and said very proud of how Jody had behaved telling him that since then he could ride along with the "men".

slime thing.name: Slime-Thing
slime thing.origin: The Slime-Thing drifted aimlessly across the Solar System until landing on a satellite orbiting Earth. When the satellite was destroyed, it crashed in one of Earth's oceans, where it remained for two years, building itself a humanoid body. Humanoid form|thumb|left Once finished, it swam into the surface. It came upon Sub-Mariner locked in combat. Slime-Thing forced Namor underwater, but was defeated by the sea-prince. In response, it ditched its body and left the Solar System.
